articleTitle: Research and Countermeasures on Fire and Explosion Risk of Hydrogenation Station Based on Fault Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Due to its clean, high-efficiency, safe and sustainable development characteristics, hydrogen energy is regarded as the most promising clean energy worldwide. The hydrogen energy industry has been included in China's "14th Five-Year Plan." With the rapid development of the hydrogen energy industry in China, the large-scale construction of hydrogenation stations will face substantial safety problems. In this paper, the fault tree analysis (FTA) method is used to carry out a comprehensive risk analysis and judgment on the hydrogenation stations, sort out the dangerous and harmful factors, and put forward preventive countermeasures in the operation of the hydrogenation stations, so as to ensure its safe and long-term operation and resolutely curb the occurrence of serious accidents.

articleTitle: Detection of spontaneous explosion of transmission line insulators based on improved Mask-RCNN algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the high missed detection rate and slow detection speed of transmission line insulator self-explosion defect detection, a deep learning algorithm based on improved Mask-RCNN is proposed for the detection of insulator selfexplosion defect. First, a fusion factor is introduced to the FPN network of the Mask-RCNN feature extraction and feature fusion link to improve the detection ability of small target self-explosion defects and reduce the missed detection rate. Secondly, an improved NMS algorithm is used in the Mask-RCNN network to replace the classic NMS (nonmaximum suppression) algorithm to improve the speed of real-time detection of self-explosive defects. Finally, the experimental results show that compared with the Mask-RCNN algorithm, the improved algorithm significantly improves the detection speed and accuracy, mAP reaches 96.9%, and has strong recognition robustness.

articleTitle: CORDIC-based FOC control of polar coordinate systems and FPGA implementation
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Due to the traditional space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) and vector rotation transformation based on the Cartesian coordinate system are cumbersome, complex and resource-intensive, a FOC control algorithm based on the polar coordinate system is proposed. For the SVPWM modulation of the method, the vector modulus length and rotation angle are directly provided by the polar coordinate system, which is convenient to frequency conversion and voltage control. In addition, aiming at the coordinate transformation module, the PARK transformation is simplified to an efficient iterative calculation suitable for computers through the coordinate rotation digital computer (CORDIC) algorithm, and the inverse PARK transformation is converted to the angle addition operation by usage of the polar coordinate system. Therefore, the decoupling and modulation in the algorithm are simplified through the two advanced modules, which is beneficial to the realization in field programmable gate array (FPGA) and reduces the calculation. The simulation and experiment denote that the algorithm have reduced the hardware resource consumption and improve the computing efficiency.

articleTitle: Overview of HVDC Auxiliary Control Technology to Improve the Transient Stability in Receiving Side Power Grid of UHVDC
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Long distance and large capacity power transmission is an important characteristic of China's power grid, and HVDC has become an important form of transmission. With the continuous construction of UHVDC transmission projects and the increasing proportion of renewable energy and other types of generating resources, UHV AC / DC receiving side power grid presents the characteristics of more complex power coupling, multiple voltage regulation means and different voltage response characteristics of controlled objects. The voltage security, reliability and economic operation of UHV AC / DC receiving side power grid are facing new challenges. DC system has the advantages of fast controllable power, large adjustable capacity and short-term overload ability. Through appropriate auxiliary control, the transient stability performance of AC / DC system can be effectively improved. Though DC auxiliary control was widely applied, it can be improved by considering the structural characteristics and stability characteristics of AC power grid, the coordination with AGC in AC system, the optimal coordination of multi time scale dynamic reactive power, the coordination with flexible DC system, and the design considering the characteristics of generation-grid-load-storage, so as to play a greater role.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Development Optimization in the North China Power Grid under Low Carbon Target
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: China's "emission peak and carbon neutrality" target puts forward new requirements for the development of renewable energy, and in the future, a high proportion of renewable energy will become a distinctive feature of the power system. Based on the resource endowment and power system planning in North China, this paper assesses the renewable energy development needs of the North China Power Grid in the future, and takes into account the technical and economic development trends of renewable energy power generation to optimize the installed capacity proportion of renewable energy in the North China Power Grid, in an attempt to promote the healthy development of renewable energy and enhance the friendliness of the power grid.

articleTitle: The balance capacitor’s control strategy of non-isolated three-level bidirectional Buck / Boost converter
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Studying and analysing natural rainfall information and rain components is an important way to explore meteorological and geological changes. In order to obtain local rainfall information and collect rainfall samples, this paper designed a rainfall monitoring and automatic sampling system suitable for karst and other special geomorphological features. The sampling function uses the method of combining the infrared sensor and a designed positioning plate. Using the lowspeed motor drives the water diverter to be accurately positioned above the corresponding sample bottle. The monitoring function adopts a rain gauge, which uses the electromagnetic characteristics of the magnetic switch to collect rainfall signals. The rainfall information and bottle changing information are recorded in the FLASH memory by use of the lowpower STM32 controller. After field testing, all functions are operating normally and meet the requirements of relating research.

articleTitle: Sensorless control strategy for permanent magnet synchronous linear motor based on nonlinear flux linkage observer
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: A nonlinear flux linkage observer applied to a sensorless control method of a permanent magnet synchronous linear motor is proposed to observe the position and velocity of PMLSM. The principle of the conventional flux linkage observer is introduced, and the corresponding shortcomings are listed, while the proposed method has the advantages of more accurate position estimation and relatively easy implementation with less complicated calculation, while the proven phaselocked loop (PLL) calculation method is introduced for the speed calculation, and the feasibility of the method is verified for PMLSM under no load in a certain speed domain.

articleTitle: Research on key problems of power market design to adapt to the construction of new power system in China
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: At present, China has been accelerating the implementation of the carbon neutralization goal and the construction of a new power system. New energy will gradually become the main body of installed capacity and electricity. Coal power will bear more functions of system regulation and balance. The power grid structure and operation mode will be more complex and diversified. The development of power system and market construction are facing new challenges and major changes. It is important to address the innovation of market design to ensure the low-carbon energy transformation and safe and reliable power supply. A market mechanism is needed which is suitable for the technical and economic characteristics of new energy. The construction of capacity and auxiliary service market should be accelerated, as well as the full utilization of new flexible resources such as demand side response.

articleTitle: Coupling estimation of SOC and SOH of backup power supply based on deep learning
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Backup power supply is very important to ensure the normal operation of underground safety system. State of charge (SOC) and state of Health (SOH) are the key state quantities of backup power supply. At present, they are decoupled and estimated, and SOH depends on experience; However, the current SOC estimation method has low accuracy and does not consider SOH. There will be a huge difference in accuracy before and after the service life of backup power battery. In order to realize the coupling estimation of power SOC and SOH, this paper proposes a joint estimation method of SOC and SOH based on deep learning by analyzing the correlation between backup power SOC and SOH. Through the gated cycle unit cycle neural network and convolution neural network, the voltage, current and temperature of the backup power supply are used to realize the simultaneous estimation of SOC and SOH in the whole service life of the power supply, and the estimated value of SOH is taken into account in the SOC estimation to eliminate the negative impact of the aging factor of the power supply battery on the SOC estimation, so as to improve the estimation accuracy, Realize reliable and accurate self state perception of backup power supply.

articleTitle: Research on the improvement of renewable energy consumption capacity and statistical methods on the user side
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Historically, the problem of new energy overspeed planning and construction in China has been prominent. Relying solely on traditional thermal power has great pressure on peak shaving, which is difficult to deal with the intermittency and volatility of new energy power generation, resulting in a severe consumption situation. It is urgent to explore ideas and innovate to solve the difficulties of new energy consumption. In recent years, electric energy substitution has been paid more and more attention, and has become an important driving force of the revolution on the energy consumption side. This paper proposes a method to expand the load volume, improve the load response load proportion, and promote the user side to solve the problem of new energy consumption through electric energy substitution. According to the transaction characteristics of different users, this paper studies and puts forward the statistical analysis method of users' consumption of renewable energy, which can effectively evaluate the consumption ability of users for new energy.

articleTitle: Power Speech Feature Output Model Based on Convolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In the development of power industry, power data communication network plays a key role in power grid management informatization, dispatching intellectualization and operation marketization, and it is an important part of power information infrastructure. The voice communication feature analysis in the process of transmitting information can maintain strong timeliness and transmit more complex data types. This paper uses a speech recognition and speech synthesis module to complete the application of voice interaction technology under the distribution station platform. Transfer learning is introduced to improve the recognition rate of a small number of words in the power distribution station. At the same time, a Transformer model based on feature words is built in the acoustic model, which improves the transcription ability and speed of the acoustic model from Pinyin to text. Experiments show that this method has great technical advantages in accelerating the decoding process from spectrum to waveform. Compared with other methods, the training speed and inference speed are increased by 3.4% and 5.6% respectively, and the vocoder generation effect is better than that of the comparison method, which improves the recognition accuracy. Using voice to control the distribution station can greatly improve the intelligence of the distribution station, and it is also more convenient and fast. Therefore, the application of this method in the smart substation has important economic value.

articleTitle: Analysis of surge breakdown of airborne electronic controller
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the increasing degree of electrification on civil aircraft, a large number of airborne electronic equipment is used. In order to ensure that aircraft operation is in the expected environment and comply with airworthiness, electromagnetic environmental tests should be carried out in accordance with RTCA/DO-160. The failure of an electronic controller occurred many times on an certain aircraft type. In the investigation, it was found that the MOSFET in the electronic controller was broken down by the surge voltage generated directly by the electronic valve with the effect of coupling between cables. In this paper, the failure mechanism is analyzed by conducting different laboratory tests and tests on aircraft, and the relevant electromagnetic tests of the electronic controller are compared and analyzed. It is concluded that electromagnetic tests based on RTCA/DO-160 are difficult to cover the impact of surge voltage on electronic equipment, and relevant improvement suggestions are given.

articleTitle: Analysis on key points of environmental impact assessment of offshore wind power project
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The advantages and functions of offshore wind power driven by the current “carbon neutrality” target are becoming more and more obvious. It is of great significance to do a good job in the environmental impact assessment of such projects to reduce the adverse impact of offshore wind power construction on the ecological environment from the source. By analyzing the key points of environmental impact assessment of offshore wind power projects, this paper puts forward some suggestions on the ecological environment protection of offshore wind power construction, so as to further reduce the environmental impact of engineering construction and protect the marine ecological environment.

articleTitle: Salinity gradient power generation based on electrodialysis technology and its combination with varied technologies
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to deal with the environmental pollution rendered by energy production, new energy sources have attracted wide attention. Salinity gradient power (SGP), which locates at the junction of sea water and river water, is a new type of power generation technology with potential for reverse electrodialysis (RED) that uses SGP to generate electricity. Focusing on the factors that affect RED power generation, this article discussed its power generation devices including ion exchange membranes (IEMs), spacers, and electrode systems. Additionally, the combination of RED with several different technologies was introduced. It is expected that this article could certain guidance for the theoretical research and practical application of RED.

articleTitle: Research on flexible self-biased magnetoelectric transducer for non-contact power transmission line
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problems of excessive dependence on DC bias magnetoelectricity, too large size and low sensitivity of existing magnetoelectric sensors in power grid transmission lines, a flexible self-biased magnetoelectric transducer design method for current detection was proposed. The designed magnetoelectric transducer can reach a magnetoelectric voltage coefficient of 17.65V/(cm·Oe) in the zero-bias state, and has excellent magnetoelectric response performance. The current monitoring capability of the transducer is verified on the built current test platform. The results show that the sensitivity of the transducer is 33.07mV/A when the power frequency current is 50Hz, which has excellent sensitivity and linearity. The field has great application value and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Electricity determination mechanism for renewable energy to participate in the market
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy in China in recent years, the traditional full-amount purchase method is difficult to adapt to the power system with a high proportion of renewable energy. Therefore, it is necessary to consider renewable energy generation in power construction and establish a mechanism for renewable energy to participate in the electricity market. Renewable energy's participation in the market power determination mechanism is the basis for renewable energy's participation in the market. This paper focuses on this issue. This paper proposes a centralized mechanism for renewable energy to participate in the determination of market electricity, and compares and analyzes several mechanisms. Finally, a recommended way for renewable energy to participate in the determination of market power is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Revision and Drawing of the Distribution Map of Ice Zones in China Southern Power Grid
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Scientific and credible ice zones’distribution map is significant in design, operation and maintenance of power transmission lines. This study uses the ice disaster data of Yunnan and Guizhou provinces from 2018 to 2021, by following the basic principles of revision and drawing, the ice area level adjustment is made in both ice area maps of parts of Guizhou and Yunnan 2018. The specific changes are as follows: the ice level of Yongshan, Huize, Luliang and Wenshan Qiubei in Yunnan Zhaotong County, Bijie Dafang Area in Guizhou are appropriately increased; Kunming Economic Development Zone, Yunnan, and Southwestern Guizhou’s ice zone is appropriately lowered.

articleTitle: Prediction of photovoltaic power generation probability based on gaussian mixture model
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In view of the strong randomness and uncertainty of photovoltaic output affected by the environment, this paper proposes a method for predicting photovoltaic output based on a Gaussian mixture model. Based on the factors that affect photovoltaic output, clustering algorithm is used to classify historical data, the improved BP neural network is used to predict the classified pv data. From the prediction error, the Gaussian mixture model is established by the EM method, and finally the probability model of photovoltaic output is obtained. The simulation results show that the PV output prediction performance of the proposed method is better than a single Gaussian distribution, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Indoor Pedestrian Dead Reckoning Algorithm Based on MEMS Inertial Sensor
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Pedestrian Dead Reckoning (PDR), with its strong autonomy and high short-term positioning accuracy, rapidly becomes one of the hot spots of indoor positioning research.However, traditional PDR algorithm has some limitations. On the basis of a large number of research, this paper proposes a pedestrian position adaptive fitting algorithm based on Micro Electro Mechanical System (MEMS) sensor.In this algorithm, the motion state of the foot is judged by zero-crossing detection and short-term invariance of gait, and step length of pedestrian is fitted by self-adaptive acceleration. Finally, the trajectory of pedestrian motion is obtained by calculating pedestrian position. Through repeated tests, it is concluded that the maximum error is less than 1.5 meters within the distance of 95 m, which has a good practical application prospect.

articleTitle: Terahertz Single Image Super-Resolution reconstruction algorithm based on the deep residual network
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Glass fiber reinforced plastics (GFRP) are widely used in aviation, electrical insulating materials and chemical equipment. But its production quality is not stable. Through fast scanning imaging by Terahertz (THz) domain spectrometer to identify small defects in the image, usually obtaining only a single original image with low resolution (LR). Therefore, improving the resolution of terahertz image has become a research hotspot. In this paper, we propose a Terahertz Single Image Super-Resolution (SISR) method based on residual networks for non-destructive testing (NDT) of composite materials, using prefabricated defects as samples. In order to improve the resolution of terahertz images, a very deep convolutional neural network (VDCNN) based on residual learning which is based on the Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN) is constructed. This network can be used for Super-Resolution reconstruction of original LR images at terahertz. The effect of network layer number on Super-Resolution performance under different scaling time is studied. Over time, Super-Resolution performance improves. In addition, the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity (SSIM) are calculated, and the results show that the high resolution (HR) image based on the deep residual network is superior to the traditional method.

articleTitle: Medium and low voltage fault determination method based on cloud-edge collaboration
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of the distribution network in recent years, its scale is increasing, the network structure is becoming more and more complex, the types of equipment are increasing, the operation mode is changing, the distribution is becoming wider and wider, and there are more and more uncertain factors, problems such as power outages in the distribution network can easily lead to serious consequences. Therefore, the identification and determination of distribution network faults have received more attention, and it is urgent to conduct targeted assessments of distribution networks to prevent accidents in advance, reduce fault hazards, and reduce fault losses. This paper proposes a medium and low voltage fault determination method based on cloud-edge coordination, which effectively reduces the power failure identification time of the distribution network and improves the efficiency of the emergency repair of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Comparison and optimization of transmission line tower structures
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to reduce the corridor width occupied by the transmission line tower and make it economical, based on the 220kV line project of chentangzhuang power plant Yingfeng substation, through the comparison and selection of three different insulator string layout types and the selection of planning span, the "L-shaped insulator string" layout type and tower design parameters conducive to reducing the corridor width are obtained, which can provide reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Frequency regulation control of charging pile load aggregator based on variable target control strategy
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: High proportion of renewable energy connected to the grid will become the inevitable development trend and important feature of the world power system in the future. Due to the low inertia of the power grid with a high proportion of renewable energy, the frequency change rate in the power grid is usually very high. Before the primary frequency modulation response, the frequency drop caused by the disturbance is likely to exceed the action threshold of the low-frequency load shedding device. The variable objective control proposed in this paper divides the active power control of the load aggregator into two stages. The first goal is the fast power balance stage based on local frequency deviation, including early fast power injection to prevent the rapid change of frequency in a short time after disturbance; The second stage is to respond to the secondary frequency modulation command sent by the system. This control method can reduce the frequency drop of the system, and can quickly restore the system frequency to the rated frequency.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Grid-side Energy Storage Considering Renewable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the transformation of China's energy structure, the rapid development of new energy industry is very important for China. A variety of energy storage technologies based on new energy power stations play a key role in improving power quality, consumption, frequency modulation and power reliability. Aiming at the power grid side, this paper puts forward the energy storage capacity allocation method for substation load reduction, peak shaving and valley filling, and analyzes the actual data of a regional power grid; The benefit calculation model is established from the power grid side. Through the example analysis, it is concluded that the energy storage power station can obtain good economic benefits.

articleTitle: The Demand & Potential Analysis Method of New Energy Development under the Constraint of Carbon Neutrality
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Recently, China had set 2030 and 2060 carbon emission targets, and the new energy based on wind power and photovoltaic became the main growth point of power in the future. The limited flexible adjustment resource of power system which resulted in the lack of consumption capacity was the bottleneck with the development of new energy. In this background, it was crucial matter to design the reasonably new energy developing scenario to satisfy the carbon emission constraint. Therefore, the demand & potential analysis of new energy development was studied in this paper to balance the low-carbon development target and safe and economic operation of power system. Moreover, the new energy generation scale and the reasonable power storage system arrangement were proposed in Jilin province.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Control Algorithm of Overhead Robot
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The robot control algorithm is the core of the overhead robot control system. The primary task of overhead robots used for high-risk high-voltage wire inspection operations is to ensure that the control system has strong anti-interference ability and control accuracy, and strive to improve the speed of the robot control system. In this paper, the robot obstaclenevigation is decomposed into the individual control of each manipulator, and the motion planning is organically unified to complete the task of robot crossing the obstacle. The fuzzy control algorithm is used to adapt the crawling of the robot at different angles and different degrees of slippage. For the control of the manipulator, an adaptive fuzzy PID control algorithm with variable universe is proposed to meet the requirements of high control difficulty, complex tasks and high control accuracy of the manipulator. Finally, according to the actual situation of the robot, a task plan based on internal pose measurement is designed, and a knowledge base for determining the completion of the action is established to realize the obstacle-crossing movement of the overhead robot.

articleTitle: A Protocol for Metro Train Control Communication Network Based on TRDP
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: A protocol for train control communication network based on train real-time data protocol (TRDP) which includes connect/disconnect administration, data communication, data encryption and data decryption is proposed. Base on TRDP, this protocol gives the definition of connect/disconnect administration by user datagram protocol (UDP) to suit train control communication network, and archive encryption and decryption by SM4 to satisfy the real time, safety and availability requirements of control communication network.

articleTitle: Transformer oil temperature monitoring system based on SWA sensor
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As the key equipment in the operation of power facilities, the transformer is the power equipment that the power sector pays attention to in the daily maintenance. The operation and maintenance personnel mostly use the method of on-site visual inspection to initially judge whether the operation status of the transformer is normal. This method is timeconsuming and not accurate enough. To solve the above-mentioned problems, a passive wireless intelligent sensing system based on surface acoustic wave is designed and a new device is proposed. Its working mechanism is to monitor the oil level (oil level), oil level and Parameters such as temperature and external ambient temperature are used to judge the operating status of the transformer. These parameters are transmitted to the backend of the operation and maintenance department through the 5G network, which is beneficial for the operation and maintenance personnel to centrally manage the transformers in the area.

articleTitle: Construction of Provincial Intelligent Dispatching System Suitable for Consumption of Hydropower
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the popularization of the concept of clean and low-carbon development, it has become a social consensus to further utilize clean energy such as small hydropower. For provinces rich in small hydropower, taking Zhejiang Province in China as an example, various traditional dispatching methods in the past have never been able to completely solve the problem of optimal dispatching. This paper innovatively proposes a dispatch strategy method based on the joint optimization of provinces and cities, the joint optimization of watersheds, and the joint optimization of cascade hydropower plants, and forms and implements the corresponding algorithm, which better solves the optimal dispatching problem of small hydropower. Based on this, this paper further designs a hydropower smart dispatching platform suitable for the optimization and consumption of small hydropower in the provincial area. The platform has the characteristics of safety, reliability, advanced and practical, open expansion, easy management and maintenance. Realize the problem of intelligent optimization and dispatch of provincial hydropower, and has universal applicability, which can be applied to similar power grids and has general guidance.

articleTitle: Research on Vacuum Circuit Breaker Optimization Based on Permanent Magnet Operating Mechanism
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, the rapid expansion of the scale of the power grid and the rapid development of the power industry, many industries on the quality of electricity and reliable power put forward new requirements, permanent magnetic operating mechanism is an important component of circuit breakers, this paper first introduced the background and mathematical model of permanent magnetic vacuum circuit breakers, and then on the Ansys Maxwell platform to establish a single-steady permanent magnetic vacuum circuit breaker two-dimensional axis symmetrical electromagnetic field model, using finite meta-analysis method to obtain the dynamics of permanent magnets. This paper analyzes the influence of the key factors such as permanent magnet material, capacitor precharge pressure and coil turn number on the drive force, speed and splitting time of the reprehension disk, and obtains the best parameter interval for the circuit breaker to run properly, which provides some simulation method and theoretical guidance for the optimal design of the permanent magnet operating mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment method of power grid engineering cost
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the continuous development of my country's economy, the construction scale of power grid projects has become larger and larger, so the investment cost of power grid projects has increased accordingly. Power grid projects have the characteristics of long construction period and many factors affecting cost management. Therefore, it is of great significance to construct a reasonable risk assessment method model of power grid project cost for improving the level of project cost control and investment efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on optimal delivery capacity allocation model of combined wind-PV-thermal-storage considering balance of economy and energy saving
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to alleviate the serious problems of new energy consumption, a certain scale of energy storage equipment is configured to consume the power abandonment of the external transmission system. In this context, taking into account the economic and energy-saving coordination and balance indexes, this paper analyzes the current situation of China's wind and solar resources, takes 50% of renewable energy power and 10% of power rejection rate in the outward transmission channel as the goal, establishes the optimization model of the combined outward transmission capacity of wind and photovoltaic powers, thermal power and storage, and proposes the calculation process. A typical new energy base under the DC transmission to North China power grid is selected for example analysis. The results show that configuring a certain scale of energy storage facilities and gradually improving the flexibility of thermal power technology can meet the requirements of 50% of renewable energy in the transmission channel and the requirements of power abandonment rate, which provides a basis for the planning and construction of relevant enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on a high performance computing architecture for edge computing
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: For the application of image, audio and natural language understanding in power industry, a cloud edge collaboration framework is proposed, including model update and sample synchronization mechanism. Under this collaborative framework, aiming at the application of edge artificial intelligence, a solution of edge equipment with high performance and high reliability is proposed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of Stochastic Nonstrict-Feedback Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Hysteresis
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: For stochastic nonlinear systems with unknown hysteresis, an adaptive tracking control based on neural networks is proposed. Under backstepping framework, by employing radial basis function neural networks to approximate unknown nonlinear function, an adaptive control law is designed. It is proved that the controller can ensure that the signal of the system remain bounded, and the system output converges to within a small neighborhood of the desired signal. Finally, an experiment result show the feasibility of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Grounding Reliability of 110kV Shared Tower under Lightning
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to obtain the electromagnetic transient characteristics of the shared tower under lightning strike and the influence of different grounding schemes on the grounding reliability of the shared tower, a 110 kV shared tower model under lightning strike is established, and the transient potential and current distribution of the tower top and the grounding body are calculated. Finally, the influence of grounding type on the grounding reliability of the tower is analyzed from the perspective of ground potential rise balance and tower lightning protection performance. The results show that before and after the tower sharing, the lightning overvoltage amplitude deviation at the top of the tower and the cross arm position is small, which will not affect the lightning protection performance of the tower. When the base station network is equip potential connected to the tower network, the ground potential rise is significantly reduced and the potential balance is improved. The research results provide guidance and reference for the grounding scheme of shared tower.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study on Indirect Measurement of Grounding Resistance of Complex Grounding Grid
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The condition of the grounding device is closely related to the safe and reliable operation of the power system. It is of great significance to scientifically and reasonably test various parameters of the grounding device and accurately evaluate its condition. In order to solve the problem of inaccurate measurement of the resistance value of the complex ground network, this paper proposes an indirect measurement method. First, measure the resistance value of a simple ground that is not too far away from the complex ground, then connect the complex ground to the simple ground, and inject current at both ends of the connecting lead to obtain the total resistance of the loop. By measuring the simple ground to raise the potential, modify the loop resistance to obtain the grounding resistance of the complex ground network. And use the ground network analysis software CDEGS to carry on the modeling analysis, demonstrate the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Energy Storage Load Aggregator Participating in Interactive Trading
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the increasing development of energy storage technology, energy storage equipment is widely used, and with the construction of new power system, a large number of new energy units are put into operation, which brings great uncertainty to the output of power system. Therefore, the value of energy storage is gradually reflected. At the same time, the state has gradually issued relevant policies to encourage energy storage load aggregators to participate in the power market. The rechargeable energy storage load aggregator connects the aggregated resources through advanced information and communication technology and software system, and serves as a power supply coordination management system for a special power plant to participate in the power market and power grid operation. Aiming at the scenario of energy storage load aggregators participating in the power market, this paper studies the corresponding interactive trading mechanism, analyzes the characteristics of energy storage load aggregators and the distribution of benefits from participating in the market, and finally assumes an interactive trading mechanism suitable for energy storage load aggregators and the trading varieties that energy storage load aggregators can participate in the market, By designing an interactive trading mechanism involving energy storage load aggregators, we can lay a foundation for future energy storage facilities to further participate in the power market, improve the utilization rate of energy storage facilities and promote the consumption of new energy under the new power system.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Predition and Self-healing Control Technology of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of reliability requirements for distribution network, intelligent distribution network control technology develops rapidly. In this paper, a soft self-healing control scheme for distribution network faults is proposed. The intelligent algorithm based on LITF-LSTM is used to predict faults, and the actual power network can isolate faults in advance according to the predicted results. The comparison between soft self-healing scheme and hard self-healing scheme proves that soft self-healing control has more important significance for ensuring power supply quality and building smart power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors of cost of new substation project based on complex information mining
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The scale of investment and construction of new substation projects is large, and there are many influencing factors in the construction process, which increases the difficulty of cost control of new substation projects to a certain extent. Therefore, combined with the statistical mining of the historical engineering information of the new substation project, this paper identifies and analyzes the influencing factors of the project cost, and provides a reference and basis for the power grid enterprises to improve the project cost control level and the project construction benefit level.

articleTitle: Shortest Path Planning Method for Cable Laying Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to better lay the cable scientifically, a cable laying shortest path planning method based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Combined with improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, the cable laying management model is constructed, the cable laying shortest path planning system is improved, and the evaluation index of cable laying shortest path planning is constructed. Finally, it is confirmed by experiments, the shortest path planning method of cable laying based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm has high practicability and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Motion Planning of Autonomous Driving Vehicles Based on Search Algorithms and Motion Primitives
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Motion planning for autonomous vehicles not only requires real-time planning of maneuverable trajectories, but also requires it to have good environmental adaptability. This paper takes the intelligent vehicle as the research object, and establishes the kinematics/dynamics model of the vehicle and the kinematics monorail python model. Based on the manipulating automaton generator provided in CommonRoad and the parameters of the vehicle model actually established, a set of motion primitives suitable for general urban roads is generated. Through the improved A* search algorithm, a maneuvering automaton is constructed, and the results show that feasible solutions can be obtained under typical road traffic conditions, and the algorithm is effective and stable.

articleTitle: A Study on the Key Issues of Electricity Spot Market Construction in Guizhou Province, China
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to achieve the strategic goal of "carbon peak and carbon neutrality", it is urgent to build a new electricity market system with new energy as the main body. With the rapid development of the load characteristics of the Guizhou power grid and the rapid development of new energy, it is urgent to accelerate the construction of the Guizhou power spot market, and solve the problem of optimal allocation of resources through time- and location-based price signals. This article takes Guizhou's power supply structure and the current power market construction and development as a breakthrough point to analyze the necessity of Guizhou's construction of a power spot market. Research shows that there are still some problems in the construction of the electricity market-oriented trading mechanism in Guizhou Province. The construction of the power spot market in Guizhou can be transformed by optimizing the way that clean energy participates in the market, connecting electric energy and ancillary services, encouraging user-side participation in the market, and rationally disposing of unbalanced funds, so as to provide new ideas for its development.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Path of Management and Operation Mechanism of Regional Interconnected Power Grid Based on the Integration of Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: On June 30, 2020, with the installation of the power distribution network interconnection switch of Jiashan Wujiang distribution network, the "power barrier" between the two places was officially broken. Qingpu, Wujiang and Jiashan are all in the ecological green integrated development demonstration area of the Yangtze River Delta. So far, they have realized ring network interconnection. Thus, the reliability of power supply has been greatly improved. Firstly, this paper investigates the management and operation mechanism of the interconnected power grid. We focus on the management coordination, operation wiring, power bill settlement, operation and maintenance emergency repair coordination and other mechanism. Then we put forward reasonable suggestions for the future development path of the management and operation mechanism of regional interconnected power grid.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic quantitative evaluation of comprehensive efficiency of smart grid investment based on G1-entropy weight method
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Smart grid is the trend of future power grid development and plays an important role in promoting the development of power industry and energy structure adjustment. In this paper, the comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation system of smart grid investment is studied deeply. Firstly, the connotation, characteristics and goals of smart grid development in China are studied, and the corresponding methods are proposed. Then, starting from the characteristics of smart grid technology, the comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation index system of smart grid investment is constructed from the aspects of technology, reliability, efficiency, economy and environmental protection. Secondly, the economic characteristics of smart grid are analyzed in depth, and g1-entropy weight method is used to evaluate the comprehensive energy efficiency of smart grid in a certain region. Finally, this paper summarizes the comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation of smart grid investment, which has a guiding role in the comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation of smart grid investment in the future.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Electron Transport Parameters in Gas Discharge
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Electron transport parameters (electron mobility, electron diffusion coefficient, ionization rate coefficient) is very important parameter about fluid models of gas discharge. In general, we have the electron energy distribution function by using solving the Boltzmann equation in plasma discharge and then can calculated electron transport parameters. This article solved the electron Boltzmann equation (BE) under the freely available name BOLSIG+, and analysis mode parameters (reduced electric, ionization degree, field frequency) influence on Electron transport parameters and provide reliable data information to gas discharge mode. Numeration results show, with increase of reduced electric, air and methane high energy electron number increase, mean energy also increase, mobility reduce ,but diffusion coefficients have different trend; With increase of ionization degree, high energy electron number increase, and electron energy distribution function change inconspicuous when ionization degree less than10-3,the mobility and ionization rate coefficients increase, but diffusion coefficients have litter reduce; With increase of ionization degree, high energy electron number decrease, mean energy also decrease, mobility and diffusion coefficients have also decrease different degree.

articleTitle: Design of PI-adaptive All-Digital Phase-Locked Loop based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the mutually exclusive problem of locking speed and anti-noise ability in All-Digital Phase-Locked Loop (ADPLL) with fixed Proportion-Integral (PI) parameters, an adaptive PI parameter ADPLL based on fuzzy control is designed in this paper. Firstly, the phase-domain mathematical model is established and an adaptive control rule is obtained by analogizing the bandwidth theory of Analog Phase-Locked Loop. Then, a PI parameters adaptive controller based on fuzzy control algorithm is designed to adjust the PI parameters of loop filter. The ADPLL system design and simulation experiments are completed in Simulink. The results show that the new ADPLL has locking speed of high bandwidth and anti-noise stability of low bandwidth. It can complete the frequency and phase locking in 13 cycles of input signal and its anti-noise stability is close to the bandwidth-ratio 0.03.

articleTitle: Analysis and study on external damage of provincial power optical cable
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Power optical cable damage which occur frequently in recent three years are analyzed and studied，external damage was the main style of optical cable damage. In the form of graphics, external damage is compared and deeply learned according to cable type, cause, operation and maintenance unit and occurrence month. Then, typical damage and problems are introduced. Finally come to the conclusion of improving the working mechanism of preventing external damage and strengthening the optical cable damage perception and problem-solving ability.

articleTitle: Research on Feasibility Evaluation Index System of Electrical Energy Alternative Planning Policy
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Electrical energy replacement planning is equally predictive, forward-looking and directional guidance, and has important guiding significance for electrical energy replacement. The planning effect evaluation is the basis of electrical energy replacement planning development, and is related to the overall quality and level of the power replacement planning program. Policy feasibility evaluation is an important aspect of electrical energy replacement planning, but there is currently a lack of index system for scientific and reasonable evaluation of its policy feasibility. The main reason is that electric energy replacement plans have large, uncertain factors, involving a wide range of fields. This paper is aimed at the problem of power replacement planning policy and the problem of lacking related indicator systems. Based on the existing policy system for promoting electrical energy alternative, the principle of evaluating the feasibility of electrical energy alternative is given. Finally, the content, standard and training-based packet score evaluation method for electrical energy replacement policy feasibility is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic model of the small-scale compound coaxial unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Compound helicopters have always been the focus of helicopter research, which can make up for the shortcomings of traditional helicopters with low flight speed. The small-scale compound coaxial unmanned helicopter is based on the configuration of the tail thruster, focusing on the change of pitch angle of the helicopter at a certain forward flight speed. The aerodynamic model of the helicopter is established, and the forward flight equilibrium equations are obtained. The Newton method is used to solve the equation group, obtaining the simulation data. The sample helicopter is tested in forward flight at a certain speed without tail thruster and with tail thruster, obtaining the experimental data. And comparing the simulation data with experimental data and obtaining the analysis of the results. The research shows that the aerodynamic model of the coaxial helicopter is consistent with the reality at low speed forward flight. The addition of tail thruster reduces the pitch angle of the helicopter during stable forward flight and also reduces the power consumption of the coaxial rotors.

articleTitle: Grid connected and off grid operation control strategy of cascade energy storage system based on equivalent rotor equation
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the continuous development of power electronics technology and the large-scale access of new energy power generation, the stable operation of the power grid is facing huge challenges. Medium voltage cascaded energy storage system with its high power, high conversion efficiency and high capacity utilization has received more and more attention. In this paper, firstly, the topology and internal mathematical model of cascade energy storage system are analyzed. Secondly, according to the application condition of microgrid, the high-precision closed-loop control method of power and voltage of cascade energy storage system in grid connected and off grid state is studied, and a parallel off grid switching control method based on equivalent rotor equation is proposed. Finally, a simulation model is built based on MATLAB / Simulink simulation software to verify the realizability and correctness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Ship power system modeling and monitoring alarm interface design
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the improvement of the electrification degree of modern ships, it is necessary to monitor their power system in order to ensure the safety of navigation. MATLAB/Simulink is used to establish the simulation model of the ship power system, and the simulation and research of the ship under normal working conditions and the occurrence of short circuit fault are carried out, and the change of the electrical volume during the short circuit fault of the ship power system is analyzed. This paper innovatively designs a monitoring and alarming interface for ship power system, which displays various parameters of generator set such as voltage, current and power in real time, and sets different levels of fault alarm lights, which can more intuitively display the running state of ship power system, and realize the monitoring and fault alarm functions of ship power system.

articleTitle: Optimization of the emergency disposal process of expressway tunnel accidents based on ExtendSim
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: After the accident on the expressway tunnel, how to rescue timely and effectively is the key to prevent the secondary accidents and reduce personnel casualties. Combined with the features of expressway tunnel accidents and emergency rescue, the emergency disposal process of expressway tunnel accidents is simulated with the ExtendSim simulation software in this paper. We find out the key factors affecting the efficiency of emergency response, optimize the emergency disposal process from the aspects of the structure and execution technology, and compare and analyze the disposal time and utilization rate of the emergency disposal process before and after optimization. The simulation results confirm that the efficiency of the optimized emergency disposal process is improved by 7.28%, which is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Study on temperature distribution of shore power cable under different working conditions
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Due to the long-term work in the coastal port and exposure to the air, the shore power cable is often affected by environmental factors such as solar radiation and tide. These factors aggravate the aging speed of the shore power cable, resulting in its service life far less than that of the traditional cable. Therefore, the temperature field distribution of the shore power cable under the solar radiation is calculated by using the finite element method, and the solar radiation intensity is considered, the influence of the cable surface on the solar radiation absorption ratio on the cable core temperature is calculated. Then, the change of the cable core temperature with the immersion depth is calculated, and the influence of water flow velocity and seawater convection heat transfer coefficient on the cable core temperature is considered. This paper can be used to guide the laying of shore power cables and the prediction of cable temperature.

articleTitle: Analysis of the GHG emission reduction advantage and potential of battery electric vehicle
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Under the "30 ‧ 60" carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, due to huge pressure to reduce GHG emissions from single-vehicle products level and the total GHG emissions of the automobile industry, the automobile industry faces severe challenges in achieving the dual-carbon goals. This research analyzes the life cycle GHG emissions of different fuel types of passenger cars sold in China in 2020 from the perspective of single vehicle product, and focuses on the GHG emission reduction advantages and future potential of battery electric vehicles, which can provide a reference for the realization of GHG emission reduction at the product level.

articleTitle: Wave compensation control of gangway based on model predictive control
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As a complex nonlinear system, gangway has the characteristics of parameter perturbation, strong parameter time variability, large external disturbance and uncertain model parameters Traditional PID control can not achieve effective wave compensation, and there are problems such as overshoot, jitter and slow response. Aiming at the deficiency of PID control strategy, a wave compensation control strategy based on model predictive control is proposed. Firstly, the dynamic model of gangway is established based on Lagrange equation, and then the model predictive controller is designed by linearization and discretization of the model. The advantages and disadvantages of model predictive controller and traditional PID controller are compared by MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation. The final results show that compared with the traditional PID control, the model predictive control algorithm has better vibration suppression effect and robustness. It can effectively reduce the error when the gangway reaches the steady state and realize the wave compensation for the ship under the condition of satisfying the constraint conditions.

articleTitle: Regional Partitioning Method based on Line Coherence Degree for Control System in Power Grid
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Rational partitioning method of power grid for control system is important. In a power system, the lines with similar power compositions are closely related to each other. There is a high risk of cascading overloads among them in the case of heavy loads or lines broken. A partitioning method for the security and stability control system in power grid is introduced in this study. The method can promote the clustering of transmission lines in close association, improve the work efficiency of master stations of control systems and ensure the safe and stable operation of power grids. The simulation results shows the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Towards the smart grids: Impact of Commercial and Industrial Electricity Price Adjustment on Output and Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Electricity is a crucial factor input for production. To reduce the cost of electricity for enterprises and relieve the real economy, China released the policy to reduce electricity tariffs twice for the general commercial and industrial in 2018 and 2019. The electricity price always plays a significant role in the development of smart grids. Based on the actual electricity consumption data of 209 general industrial and commercial customers in Zhejiang Province, this paper constructs an empirical model to investigate the variations in enterprise output and electricity consumption after the electricity price adjustment. The results indicate that for every 1% decrease in electricity prices, output increases by 0.83%, and electricity consumption increases by 1.15%. The decline of electricity price has a significant positive impact on the economy, and the electricity consumption of enterprises exhibit both the income and substitution effects.

articleTitle: An adaptive filtering algorithm for unknown non-Gaussian measurement noise
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the state estimation problem with non-Gaussian measurement, an adaptive filtering algorithm is proposed. The measurement noise is modeled by the heavy-tailed distribution. The variational Bayesian algorithm can be used to estimate the parameter of the measurement noise and the system state. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the versatility and improved performance of the proposed adaptive filter over conventional Kalman filters and the lower complexity than the particle filters.

articleTitle: An Electricity-theft checking method based on time-frequency correlation analysis of power big data
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Electricity theft not only affects the operating costs of power supply companies, but also causes serious harm to the safe operation and smooth transmission of the power grid. In the current trend of the big data era, the high-frequency power consumption data collected by each station is used to analyze the line loss. This method of checking electricity stealing improves the efficiency of traditional checking, but it usually focuses on the time series analysis, the frequency domain relationship between historical data is ignored. In this paper, an electricity-theft checking method based on time-frequency correlation analysis of power big data is proposed. Through analyzing the characteristic of time domain and frequency domain of power big data, the detection of suspected electricity-stealing performance are done. The calculation example shows that the time-frequency correlation analysis can effectively identify the electricity stealing users and the two methods are consistent.

articleTitle: Research and application of gob-side entry retaining technology in fully mechanized top-coal caving face with high gas content
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As coal mining conditions become increasingly severe, efficient mining of high-quality coal resources is imminent. In order to eliminate coal resource loss caused by coal pillar in section and maximize mining rate, Yechuan Coal has explored the technology of gob retaining roadway and carried out field tests by changing the existing roadway layout. By analyzing and evaluating the deficiencies of the existing support methods, the research and field test of gob-side entry retention technology were carried out in 3205 fully-mechanized caving face. According to the field measurement of roadway retention, the deformation of roadway retention is generally controlled within 200mm, and the deformation of local geological structure area is controlled within 300mm, without floor-heave phenomenon, and the deformation of both sides is controlled within 200mm. In general, the deformation of surrounding rock of roadway retention along gob is well controlled, which lays a solid foundation for the reuse of mine roadway retention.

articleTitle: An Improved Recurrent Neural Network for Industrial Control System Identification
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The rapid development of industrial automation makes the control process more and more demanding for the accuracy of system identification. Finding an effective identification model for regulating and controlling the time-critical and nonlinear process remains a difficult problem. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved recurrent neural network for industrial control system identification, called SI-RNNs, to solve the problem of insufficient prediction accuracy of the traditional RNNs in the initial time steps. SI-RNNs adds the state initialization process to determine the initial operational state of the control systems and selects the optimal state initialization steps length by perturbating feature values approach. In practical cases, it is verified that our method can effectively improve the solution accuracy of the model for industrial control process, especially in the gated recurrent neural networks capable of long-term memory.

articleTitle: Integrated energy electrothermal joint simulation system considering cost
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to realize the complementary and mutually beneficial use of multiple energy sources, establishing a comprehensive energy system has become a topic of wide concern worldwide, so it is necessary to develop a simulation system that can realize the coordinated operation of multiple energy flows. This paper first describes the basic content of the integrated energy simulation,a system planning model is proposed, finally, the transient system simulation program TRNSYS software was used in the case analysis.To build a specific park.Its modules can be simulated for various thermal problems.Through the combined application of various equipment in the park, simulation of the ambient temperature and soil temperature, the resulting thermal network system can be jointly simulated with a microgrid system containing distributed energy sources, joint Simulation of heat grid containing solar collector-air source heat pump-heat storage tank-heat pump and power grid containing photovoltaic array-wind power generatorenergy storage system, thus, the domestic water and electricity consumption of the park are simulated. Finally, the system cost is the lowest optimization goal. The proposed method can provide a reference for electrothermal interconnection operation and planning.

articleTitle: Finite-time attitude control for fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: To deal with the problems of external disturbances and uncertain model parameters in the attitude control of fixed-wing UAVs, an adaptive controller is designed to ensure the finite-time stability of the attitude. Firstly, a fixed-wing UAV attitude model with the external disturbances and uncertain model parameters is introduced based on time scale separation principle. Then, the control laws for attitude and attitude angular velocity are designed based on finite-time stability theory, respectively, and the stability of the attitude system is proved based on Lyapunov theory. Simulation results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Key Technologies of Power Market Technology Support System
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Distributed energy technology has developed rapidly in recent years, and there are a large number of distributed clean energy sources and users involved in distributed trading, however, distributed trading can introduce blockchain technology due to the small trading volume, high trading frequency, high demand fluctuation and high randomness, etc. The electricity trading model and business process are constructed, and the design architecture of the system is described in terms of general architecture and technical architecture. Then, the key technologies supporting the provincial distributed trading market are studied, mainly including privacy protection, identity authentication and massive data storage. Finally, the practical and completeness of the system is verified by developing a practically operable power trading system and conducting simulated transactions.

articleTitle: High-Reliability Supply Path Search Method Based on Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) Networks and Dijkstra’s Algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the increasing demand of key users for power supply reliability, it has become a hot research topic to make full use of and effectively integrate all kinds of multi-source heterogeneous data to provide the power supply path with optimal reliability under different power supply guarantee scenarios. This paper first carries out principal component analysis on the data contents such as the state of power grid components and the operation mode of the external environment and extracts the data features from various collection platforms. Then, based on the bidirectional long and short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) network, the environmental scene information and power grid situation information are correlated with their corresponding fault results, and the component failure rate calculation model taking into account the scene is built. Finally, the grid topology is transformed into a weighted directed graph, the Dijkstra algorithm is adopted to comprehensively consider the failure rate of each power supply path, and in this regard, the required high-reliability path is searched. The IEEE 30-node simulation example shows that the method studied in this paper is effective in searching for the most reliable power supply path for important users.

articleTitle: Fast Load Prediction of Distribution Network Equipments with Electric Vehicles Connected
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The analysis of the load characteristics of electric vehicle charging stations has strong randomness and volatility, which will have a greater impact on the power grid and microgrid, mainly reflected in the best dispatch and economic, safe, and stable operation. Therefore, it is of great significance to establish an accurate, stable and reasonable load forecasting method for electric vehicle charging stations for power grid and microgrid. This paper focuses on the research of distribution network equipment load forecasting. Aiming at the characteristics of nonlinear, strong randomness and complex historical samples of electric vehicle charging station load, this paper proposes an accurate prediction method based on AP data mining technology and NSGA-II optimized convolutional neural network, which can predict the daily load of distribution network equipment in advance according to historical load data and its influencing factors. Experimental analysis shows that the proposed prediction method has high accuracy and good stability. At the same time, it can be found that the overall peak load of the charging station on weekdays is lower than that on weekends. The average peak load on weekdays is 4.137 MW, and the average peak load on weekends is 6.679 MW, which further verifies that the index factors will have a greater impact on the equipment load of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on The Influence of Energy Storage on Transient Stability of Power System
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Energy storage has excellent active and reactive power regulation capabilities, and can provide fast power response to support grid transient stability. However, there are relatively few comprehensive studies on large-capacity energy storage supporting grid transient operation. Aiming at this problem, this paper firstly analyzed the main power angle, voltage and frequency transient stability problems in the actual operation of the power grid. Secondly, the energy storage electromagnetic transient model and the electromechanical transient model were modeled. Finally, the typical application scenarios in the actual power grid were selected for modeling, and the impact of energy storage on the system stability in each scenario was simulated and analyzed, so as to provided a reference for the comprehensive role of energy storage in practical applications.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Transmission Characteristics of Partial Discharge Signals in Cables Based on PSCAD
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: This paper first analyzes the structural parameters of the cable. Resistance, inductance, capacitance and conductance are the primary parameters of the cable. The characteristic impedance and propagation constant of the cable are derived from the primary parameters of the cable. Based on the uniform transmission line theory, the transmission law of the signal in the cable is studied. The attenuation constant alpha is determined by the series resistance and parallel conductance of the cable, which mainly affects the size of the signal, and the phase shift constant beta is determined by the series inductance and parallel capacitance of the cable, which mainly affects the signal. Propagation velocity in the cable body. Finally, a three-phase cable model is established by PSCAD/EMTDC, and the transmission law of the signal in the transmission line is verified by analyzing the amplitude, frequency and pulse width of the transmission signal in the cable, and it has a high consistency.

articleTitle: Abnormal wind speed date recognition based on convolution neural network
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Wind speed data of wind power generation is of great value in the era of big data. Accurate identification of wind speed is very important to evaluate the operation status and power prediction of the wind farm and the formulation of a dispatching plan by the power dispatching department. In this paper, a method for identifying abnormal wind speed data of wind power generation is proposed. Taking the customized data collected every day as samples, the convolutional neural network is trained. The experimental results show that the convolutional neural network can preliminarily distinguish normal samples from different types of abnormal samples. This paper analyzes the influencing factors of the experimental process and results, which provides a reference for the identification of abnormal data in the power system.

articleTitle: Current cooperative control of multiple DC-DC converter systems with inductive load
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
