abstract: Considering the tracking error and synchronization error of power system, a sliding mode cooperative control strategy based on extended state observer is proposed to solve the influence of load impedance inconsistency and load mutual inductance coupling on current dynamic consistency. Finally, Matlab / Simulink is used to model and simulate the system, and compared with the current cooperative control based on PI control. It is verified that the output consistency of the cooperative control strategy proposed in this paper is better and the current response speed is faster.

articleTitle: Design of Gas Alarm Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Nowadays, the widespread use of gas brings many conveniences to the family, but at the same time there are also safety hazards. Therefore, a gas detection alarm based on single-chip microcomputer is designed here. This system uses gas sensors, liquid crystal displays and so on to detect household gas. If there is a gas leak, an audible and visual alarm will sound. At the same time, the sensor monitors the gas concentration in real time. If the gas is discharged through the exhaust vent, the Global System for Mobile communication(GSM) is sent to the user to notify the user of the danger. The gas valve and the exhaust fan are controlled by the single-chip microcomputer to complete the emergency treatment of the gas.

articleTitle: Dynamic reconfiguration of distribution network based on expected value model
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: A heuristic method for dynamic reconfiguration of distribution network with renewable energy based on expected value model is proposed. Based on Monte Carlo simulation, typical scenarios are generated and the expected value model of dynamic reconfiguration of distribution network is established. On the basis of static reconstruction using the improved optimal flow mode method, heuristic rules for the ratio of network loss increment to change of switching operation times after network structure merging in adjacent time periods are proposed to reduce the switching operation times and obtain the optimal or approximate optimal dynamic reconstruction scheme. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation of IEEE 33 node system with renewable energy.

articleTitle: Privacy data protection method of energy Internet users based on homomorphic encryption
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: When there is a lack of data in the energy Internet, the user privacy data protection method is difficult to aggregate the data normally, which increases the time overhead and communication overhead. Based on homomorphic encryption, a privacy data protection method for energy Internet users is proposed. The method establishes an energy internet architecture based on the deployment of energy by users, aggregators, control centers and key distribution centers. The dynamic identity information of user equipment is generated in the energy Internet architecture, and the account address is obtained through a series of one-way hash operations. The address is used to design the user privacy data encryption algorithm based on homomorphic encryption, and the aggregation threshold is added through the secret sharing scheme to ensure the security of individual data. The method finds the ciphertext data with the same confusion parameters as the fault table ciphertext, participates in the aggregation operation instead of the ciphertext, and then decrypts the data to complete privacy protection. Compared with the methods based on clustering weighting and differential privacy, this method has lower time overhead and communication overhead. While ensuring data integrity, it can reduce computing cost and improve execution efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Emission Prediction Trend of Electric Power System Based on CS-SVR
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In 2015, China pledged to the world that it would achieve carbon peaking by 2030 and strive to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, and achieving power system emission reduction is a key step towards carbon neutrality in China. To respond to the call, as well as to provide theoretical support for China's goal of achieving peak carbon and carbon neutrality, a method for forecasting carbon emissions from China's power system based on the cuckoo algorithm (CS) and support vector regression (SVR) is proposed in this paper. The method used the Pearson correlation coefficient method to process the relevant influencing factors, and the influencing factors with high correlation coefficients, such as urbanisation rate, coal consumption in thermal power generation, electricity consumption in secondary industries and the amount of transmission and distribution losses, were used as inputs to the CS-SVR model, with carbon emissions as outputs. The results indicate that China will reach its carbon peak around 2030, and that the low carbon development trajectory is in a good position to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060.

articleTitle: Multi-target Ranging and Simulation Analysis Based on Cross Correlation
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Ranging is one of the most important basic functions of radar, and the essence of range measurement is to measure the signal time delay between radar and target, so the accuracy of time delay measurement will directly determine the quality of target ranging. The time delay estimation method based on cross correlation is an important time delay estimation algorithm, especially plays an important role in multi-target ranging. This paper first introduces the research background, and then presents the method based on cross-correlation time delay estimation principle and signal model, at the same time, the basic principle of matched filter is studied, and the matched filter is introduced into the multi-objective range, which improves the performance of ranging, finally through the simulation analysis, illustrates the feasibility of multiobject ranging method based on cross-correlation.

articleTitle: The balance capacitor’s control strategy of non-isolated three-level bidirectional Buck / Boost converter
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the development of the society, the performance requirement of the switching converter is getting higher and higher. Because the voltage balance on the two support capacitors on the high voltage side of the three-level Buck/Boost converter is the key to maintain the three-level waveform symmetry and the low voltage resistance of the three-level converter switching device. However, the switching device is not an idealized model ,the drive circuit is not symmetry, the delay circuit is different and another reasons will result in the two support capacitor’s voltage imbalance on the high voltage side of the three-level bidirectional Buck/Boost converter, so PI average voltage and adaptive average average strategies are adopted to solve the bias of the converter, and verify the feasibility of the average voltage strategy through simulation. and a 200W experimental prototype to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the above control strategy.

articleTitle: Coin Image Recognition Based on K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: At present, the coin recognition system has problems, such as high hardware cost and complex system structure. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a coin image recognition system based on K-nearest neighbor algorithm, the system has the advantages of low cost and high efficiency. Firstly, collecting the images of 1 angle coin, 5 angle coin and 1-yuan coin, then use the HSV color space model to obtain the color space histograms of the 1 angle coin, 5 angle coin and 1- yuan coin, and distinguish the 5 angle coin according to the H and S components of the color space histogram. Different perimeters are obtained by calculating the closed edges of the images of the 1 angle coin and the 1-yuan coin to distinguish the 1 angle coin and 1-yuan coin, and then use the K-nearest neighbor algorithm to classify and train the feature data of the coin, and finally randomly select 30 untrained images of each coin for the experiment. The experimental result shows that the system can effectively realize coin image recognition.

articleTitle: Influence of electric vehicle penetration on new power system under the background of "double carbon"
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the potential of electric vehicles to realize the "double carbon" goal of new power system. In order to minimize the total operation cost of the new power system in one day, an optimization model of the new power system with electric vehicles under the background of "double carbon" is established. A region is taken as an example for simulation, and the impact of different penetration rates of electric vehicles on the realization of the goal of "carbon peaking and carbon neutralization" of the new power system is studied from the perspective of carbon reduction effect and economy. The results show that under the new power system with the goal of "carbon peaking and carbon neutralization", the improvement of the penetration rate of electric vehicles will have a positive effect on the carbon reduction effect of the system, and it has great potential to achieve the goal of "double carbon".

articleTitle: Research on Impedance Matching Method of Four-coil Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Compared with the traditional two-coil wireless power transfer (WPT) system, the resonant coil in the four-coil WPT system is not affected by the source and the load terminal to a large extent, and when the transmission distance (the distance between the receiving coil and the transmitting coil) is fixed, there is no need to change the original electrical parameters of the system. By flexibly adjusting the distance between the driving coil and the transmitting coil or the load coil and the receiving coil, the system power supply matching and impedance matching can be realized, so that the transmission efficiency of the system is always at a high level. Based on the four-coil wireless power transfer system, a novel adaptive impedance matching method of rotation angle is proposed in this paper. By constructing and designing the embedded receiving-load coil, the impedance matching of the system can be achieved flexibly by adjusting the angle. At the same time, based on the traditional PCB technology, the mutual inductance analytical calculation method under different angles is analyzed in detail. In addition, the simulation results agree well with the experimental results. By changing the angle between the receiving coil and the load coil, the maximum efficiency of the system can be improved by 10% compared with before optimization, which fully verifies the scientific property and practicability of the method.

articleTitle: Regional integrated energy side data clustering method based on K-means
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Conventional regional comprehensive energy side data clustering method has the problem of imperfect similarity measurement model, which leads to poor clustering quality. A regional comprehensive energy side data clustering method based on K-means is designed. The coupling relation between various energy sources was clarified, the sample data of regional comprehensive energy was obtained, the nearest neighbor density value of the sample was calculated, the similarity measurement model was constructed by K-means, the data after unified dimension was cut and reassembled, and the energy side data clustering method was designed. Experimental results: The clustering quality mean values of the regional comprehensive energy side data clustering method in this paper and the other two regional comprehensive energy side data clustering methods are 0.675, 0.491 and 0.518 respectively, indicating that the clustering performance is improved after the fusion of k-means algorithm and regional comprehensive energy side data clustering method.

articleTitle: Research on Gateway Scheduling Algorithm based on Intra-Vehicle Ethernet-CAN Hybrid Network
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Due to the increasing of electronic controllers and functions of intelligent vehicles, the Intra-Vehicle Ethernet-CAN hybrid network has a large number of concurrent data interaction, resulting in a large number of heterogeneous network message data in the process of Intra-Vehicle gateway timeout, high packet loss rate, and even the failure of the driving function. In this paper, a queue scheduling model of heterogeneous network is established by analyzing the packet characteristics and communication processing flow of heterogeneous network, and a scheduling algorithm of Intra-Vehicle Ethernet-CAN hybrid network is designed. Finally, the hardware and software in-loop simulation is carried out on the Intra-Vehicle gateway hardware platform. The results illustrate the proposed scheduling algorithm can effectively reduce transparent transmission delay by 34.3%, and improve the stability of the Intra-Vehicle hybrid network.

articleTitle: Medium and low altitude CCD image Stitching based on SUFT algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the left and right tilt images of middle and low altitude CCD camera have different sizes and large deformations from the images in the middle two bands, image stitching is more difficult, a method of middle and low altitude CCD image stitching based on the SUFT registration algorithm is proposed. First, used the SUFT algorithm which is sensitive to feature points, strong in anti-interference and high registration accuracy to register the image, and then used the RANSAC algorithm to remove the mismatched points; Then, the registered images are fused to eliminate the Stitching seams, so as to realize the seamless stitching of the image. The experimental results show that the algorithm can accurately register and stitch each strip of the mid-to-low-altitude CCD image, ensuring the integrity of the target, and facilitating the identification and interpretation of the target by the intelligence processing personnel.

articleTitle: Research on Long-term Reliability of Pd/Ag Fiber Bragg Grating Hydrogen Sensor
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Owing to the advantages of small size, strong anti-electromagnetic interference ability and good gas selectivity, fiber Bragg grating (FBG) hydrogen sensor coated with palladium/silver (Pd/Ag) alloy film is used for on-line detection of dissolved hydrogen in transformer oil. However, the key factors restricting the long-term reliability of FBG hydrogen sensor are still unclear, and there is little relevant research to prove whether the sensor can work reliably in transformer oil for a long time. In this paper, the long-term reliability of Pd/Ag alloy film-coated FBG hydrogen sensor is investigated. Pd/Ag alloy films are prepared through magnetron sputtering process. The thickness of Pd/Ag alloy film is around 400 nm, and the mass percentage of Pd: Ag is about 3:1. The basic performance of the hydrogen sensors were calibrated before the experiment, the gas-phase sensitivities of Sensor 1 and Sensor 2 were 10.06 pm/% H2 and 9.55 pm/% H2 respectively. Under the condition that the oil temperature is 120 deg C and the dissolved hydrogen concentration in the oil was 2000 ppm, 50 cycles of hydrogen absorption and desorption aging experiment are carried out for a total of 100 hours. The results show a good reliability for long-term usage.

articleTitle: An uncertainty analysis method for distributed power trading with interval expansion suppression
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Uncertainty of load and distributed generation is one of the key problems affecting distributed power trading. The interval expansion of analysis results limits the application of interval analysis methods in the analysis of distributed power trading. In this paper, an affine interval analysis method to suppress interval expansion is proposed. By improving the approximate calculation method of new noise sources in non affine operation, the interval expansion of calculation results can be effectively suppressed.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Influence of Eccentricity of Permanent Magnet DC Motor on Cogging Torque
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: During the operation of the permanent magnet DC motor, the armature core and the permanent magnet interact to generate cogging torque, which causes vibration and noise of the motor, which causes the motor to fail to work normally and the device to fail. Aiming at the problems of motor vibration and noise, its working principle is analyzed, the magnetic field model based on eccentricity is established, and the influence of eccentricity on the cogging torque of permanent magnet DC motor is studied. Using simulation analysis to reasonably design the magnetic pole eccentricity can effectively suppress the cogging torque of the permanent magnet DC motor, reduce the torque output fluctuation of the motor under normal operating conditions by 20%, and realize the stable control of the motor.

articleTitle: Research on the Differential Configuration of Grid Equipment Production Costs – Taking 500kV Substation as an Example
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to meet the requirements for the cost supervision and review of transmission and distribution prices, support the high-quality operation of modern equipment management systems, strengthen lean management of power grid equipment production costs, and improve overall asset operation performance, power grid companies have carried out asset life cycle management, multi-dimensional lean reforms, and power grid maintenance Deepen the application of operation and maintenance cost. Based on the actual costs of 500kV substations, including self-operated material costs, outsourcing maintenance costs, labor costs, property insurance costs, vehicle usage fees, and power facility protection costs, this research studies the factors affecting the cost changes of 500kV substations, and uses regression analysis to locate the main influencing factors Based on this, build a cost-differentiated configuration model, calculate adjustment coefficients, implement quality and efficiency improvements, and further increase the control of the production cost of power grid equipment.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Storage and the Future State of Hydrogen Fuel Cells in the Next Decade
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Currently, the continuous development and promotion of hydrogen fuel cells remain an important challenge. Here, we have studied the performance of hydrogen fuel cells from different quantitative metrics and compared those with other hydrogen power generation methods to summarize the advantages and disadvantages of hydrogen fuel cells. Moreover, our group predicted the values of different quantitative metrics of hydrogen fuel cells in the next ten years by literature study. The whole study points out a promising future for hydrogen fuel cells. Although there are still some questions that do not have good answers at present, researchers have been studying them and have had some results, and it is believed that after many experiments, these questions can be solved in the future.

articleTitle: Simplified Analytical Algorithm of Motor Noise Waterfall Diagram Based on Sensitivity Analysis of Structural Parameters
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The noise of the motor is one of the important issues to be considered in motor design, which affects the performance of the motor and the user experience. Now the widely used noise analysis method is to simulate the motor noise waterfall diagram in the software to obtain the noise at different frequencies and speeds. But this method is very time-consuming, especially when repeatedly modifying parameters to reduce noise. Therefore, a simplified analytical algorithm of waterfall diagram based on sensitivity analysis of structural parameters is proposed to predict noise. Firstly, the sensitivity of structural parameters to electromagnetic force is obtained by optiSLang software, which provides a basis for parameter screening. Then, the selected parameters are fitted with each order of electromagnetic force in the Design-Expert software. The fitting formula is accurate enough to predict the value of each order of electromagnetic force. Next, the natural frequencies of each order of motor vibration are obtained in ANSYS Workbench, and then the motor noise at different speeds and frequencies could be calculated. In order to form a clear, systematic approach, the software program for predicting each order of electromagnetic force and displaying the simplified noise waterfall diagram is written based on Python. Compared with the values of each order of electromagnetic force and the complete waterfall diagram obtained by simulation, the calculation error of the software program is within the allowable range. The key characteristics of motor noise could also be reflected in the simplified waterfall diagram, which verifies the efficacy and rapidity of this method.

articleTitle: Person Re-identification Based on Dual-channel Attention and Local Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Aiming at improving low accuracy of existing person re-identification algorithms in dealing with low image resolution, different illumination, diverse poses, and viewing angles, this paper proposes a person re-id algorithm based on dualchannel attention and local feature fusion. After ResNet50, it is followed by the spatial attention and the channel attention to extract the global features. Then the feature map segmentation is performed to extract the local features, and a fusion feature with strong judgment is obtained. In addition, this paper adds the central loss constraint item to the triplet hard loss. The triplet_center loss joint cross-entropy loss function further to improve adaptability of the model in complex scenarios. The proposed method is compared and tested on the CUHK03, DukeMTMC-reID and Market-1501 data sets, and the accuracy of Rank-1 reached 96.1%, 89.8% and 79.8%. This algorithm makes full use of the features of different depths and the key information of interest. The module has a solid discriminative ability. Also the accuracy of mean average precision of the proposed method is better than other advanced algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Light and Small Wire Rope Vibration Absorber in Motor Controller
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The vibration damping design of the motor drive for aerospace applications should not only consider miniaturization, but also meet the heat dissipation requirements of the drive module itself, and meet the requirements of low temperature and long-term storage. Therefore, a scheme of adopting a built-in light and small steel wire rope shock absorber is proposed, and multiple shock absorbers are used in parallel to improve the reliability of the vibration damping system. By analyzing the stiffness and damping characteristics of the shock absorber, the damping performance is calculated and simulated, which shows that the shock absorber can meet the damping requirements of the drive product. On the vibration table, the steel wire rope shock absorber and the traditional rubber shock absorber were tested and compared according to the random vibration spectrum. The result shows that the steel wire rope shock absorber achieved the same damping effect as the rubber shock absorber.

articleTitle: Status of Pumped Storage Hydroelectricity and Its Future in the Next Decade: A Technical Review Based on Comparative Study
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Pumped storage is an efficient way to store energy, mainly consisting of two reservoirs and a waterwheel system connecting the upper and lower reservoirs. It uses solar and winds energy for energy storage to make fuller use of energy. At present, in Europe and the United States, new pumped storage power plants have been put into use on a large scale, so there have been fewer new pumped storage power plants in recent years. As the rapid rise of its economy in the last 30 years, China has only gradually put into use pumped storage power plants in recent years. Since pumped storage has the advantage of high efficiency and high return, the possibility of converting ordinary hydroelectric power plants into pumped storage power plants has been studied. Some of the influencing factors are geographical and environmental factors, maximum head, the ratio of head to water circuit length and wire connection distance, which are quantitatively analysed in this paper. Finally, this paper lists some advantages and disadvantages of pumped storage, analyses them with examples and gives an outlook on the development of this technology in the next decade.

articleTitle: Research on virtual power plant participating in ancillary services market for peak regulation and reserve market
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: To fully explore the ability of the virtual power plant (VPP) to participate in the ancillary service market, a clearing model for the VPP to participate in peak regulation and reserve ancillary service market has been proposed. The data matrix is established by the power grid model data and user declaration data. The clearing model is solved by using the linear programming method with bid-winning power and phase difference as decision variables and optimal income as an objective function. Finally, the example analysis verifies that the model of this paper can effectively obtain the power and marginal clearing price of each unit.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Load Potential Prediction Method Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Facing the increasing pressure of electric vehicles and residential electricity consumption, it is necessary to optimize the charging of electric vehicles without investing in the expansion of the power grid as much as possible, and flexibly to control the charging of electric vehicles at the appropriate time to meet the electricity demand of as many electric vehicles as possible. It can supply energy to other loads in the power supply area and relieve the peak pressure of the power grid as to ensure that the total load regulation electric quantity of the regional power grid is as small as possible and the peak load curve is as obvious as possible. The charging and discharging fuzzy clustering model of electric vehicles connected to the grid is established to ensure the energy supply of other loads in the power supply area and relieve the load of peak pressure of the power grid. The quadratic programming algorithm is used to solve the charging or discharging situation of electric vehicles in a day, which not only achieves the goal of charging electric vehicles but also has little impact on the grid, and improves the load curve of the grid. It also provides a new way to tap the potential factors of reducing the load of the power grid.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Power Flow of Distribution Network Considering Wind Power and Intelligent Energy Consumption of Residents
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's living standards, the problem of seasonal peak load of power grid is becoming more and more prominent. Promoting residents' load participation in power grid interaction is of great significance to improving power grid quality and efficiency. Therefore, this paper makes an in-depth study on the dynamic power flow of distribution network considering wind power and smart energy consumption of residents. Firstly, based on the power grid demand response, the optimal electricity price and residents' intelligent energy consumption response load model are established. Secondly, considering the uncertainty of wind power, the dynamic power flow model of distribution network with wind power and residents' intelligent energy consumption is established. Finally, based on ieee33 bus system, the dynamic power flow results of distribution network in different periods are analyzed through simulation examples to verify the effectiveness of this study.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Research and Judgment Technology of Low-Voltage Faults in Distribution Networks Based on "Cloud-edgeside Collaboration"
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With economic development and the increasing scale of power grids, power grid systems have increasingly higher requirements for fault handling efficiency. At present, 10kV faults on the medium voltage side of the distribution network can be judged and dealt with with higher efficiency through the distribution automation system to achieve the goal of improving power supply reliability; the low voltage side of the distribution network 0.4kV and below, especially to the electric meter level, has a larger number of equipment , faults occur more frequently, there is currently a lack of effective equipment monitoring methods, and the support for fault discovery and handling is not high. Processing can only be started after users call for repairs. The efficiency is low and user satisfaction is relatively low. In addition, after the fault handlers arrive at the scene, they cannot accurately locate the fault point in advance, which takes a long time to investigate, which also brings trouble to the rapid restoration of power supply. This paper proposes a comprehensive research and judgment technology for low-voltage faults in distribution networks based on “cloud-edge-side collaboration”, through the synergy of edge computing and cloud computing and the multi-dimensional data system that gathers multi-source information through edge computing research and judgment results and cloud computing, realizes accurate and efficient comprehensive research and judgment of low-voltage faults, improves power supply reliability and user satisfaction, and supports the digital transformation of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Analyze and Predict Traffic Flow by Using SVM Model
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Support vector Machine (SVM) model is a supervised machine learning algorithm, which can be applied to the classification of discrete variables and the prediction of continuous variables. Most of the time,SVM model is widely used to implement social services such as medical diagnosis, text classification and marketing. Studies have found that the traffic flow at different time points has a continuous corresponding relationship, which happens to coincide with the support vector machine (SVM) model. This article tries to use SVM model to predict the traffic flow of a certain location and a certain time.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Landing Longitude Control Technologies for UAV
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Engineering practice as the background, this paper for small fixed-wing UAV engine emergency stopping in the air, on the basis of the particle dynamics analysis, according to the characteristics of sample UAV and operating mechanism research, design a control strategy based on the flap, to overcome disadvantages that the traditional control law is unable to control the velocity and the altitude concurrently. Simulation results show that the designed control strategy can effectively achieve the UAV autonomous and stable landing.

articleTitle: Optimization of primary frequency modulation control for electric generator
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The frequency disturbance signal is sent out by Shandong Electric Power Control Center regularly and remotely, and the response of the test unit to the disturbance is in accordance with the requirements. The data collected from the network source platform are analyzed, and the analysis results and suggestions are given. Optimization is carried out after the recommendations are adopted by the power plant, and the results are verified. This paper summarizes and classifies the unqualified primary frequency modulation test results, analyzes the unqualified reasons from the operation time, the parameter setting and the speed limit, and gives the concrete solution according to the concrete reasons. After the solution is implemented by the power plant, the feasibility of the solution is verified.

articleTitle: A Brief Introduction of New Type T Tower with Cross Cross Load of 35kv Transmission Line and Design of Jumper Line of Double Loop T Tower
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the development and progress of society, people's demand for electric energy is increasing. In the current construction of 35kV transmission lines, in order to solve the problem of insufficient power supply reliability and other problems, there are more and more projects for t-connection transformation of existing lines to increase access to power supply. This paper introduces in detail the design concept and application of the new t-connection tower of 35kV transmission line cross cross load, as well as the advantages of the new T-connection technology compared with the original T-connection technology. In order to meet the needs of actual engineering construction, the double loop T tower jumper is comprehensively designed.

articleTitle: Design of time phased electricity retail package based on user demand response
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the deepening of China's electricity sales side reform and the increasingly fierce competition in the retail market, the formulation of package electricity price is the key. Under the background of building the power market in all provinces of China, it is feasible to implement the time-division power retail package. Firstly, this paper analyzes the compensation income earned by the power selling company through the user demand response, and on this basis, designs the timedivision power retail package from the aspect of maximizing the power selling interests of the power selling company, and verifies it with the actual load data. The results show that the time-division power retail package based on the user demand response can give overall consideration to the interests of power selling, users, power grid and other parties, effectively release the dividends of power system reform.

articleTitle: Application of CFD Simulation in Long Mountain Tunnel Fire
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The smoke spread and smoke exhaust scheme of subway train fire in long mountain tunnel was different from those in underground section. By establishing a large-scale unsteady model and using FLUENT software for three-dimensional simulation, the flow pattern of train fire smoke in long mountain tunnel was simulated. The influence pattern of smoke flow of the fire on the tunnel piston wind was obtained, which can guide the smoke exhaust design scheme. The smoke exhaust wind speed of subway long mountain tunnel should not only meet the requirements of critical wind speed and specifications, but also meet the requirements of restraining smoke reflux. At the same time, the specific requirements of personnel evacuation time of fire train are put forward. It provides simulation data and reference for the design of fire control and smoke exhaust scheme of subway long mountain tunnel, which is convenient to formulate reasonable ventilation and smoke exhaust scheme.

articleTitle: Event Triggered Load Frequency Control Based on Particle Swarm Optimization in Interconnected Power Systems
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Grid frequency is one of the important electric energy indexes. If there is a large deviation in the grid frequency, it will reduce the performance of power generation equipment and electrical equipment and even cause damage. Therefore, ensuring the frequency stability of power system is an important content of power system research. At the same time, with the continuous expansion of smart grid and the use of open network, it is urgent to solve the problem of excessive traffic in power system. Aiming at the problems of various disturbances that the load frequency control system may encounter and the increasing amount of communication data caused by the continuous expansion of interconnected power system, an event triggered linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) based on particle swarm optimization is proposed. Firstly, considering the influence of tie line signal and load disturbance, the mathematical model of load frequency control system in interconnected power system is established; Secondly, an event triggered LADRC is designed and its stability is analyzed; Thirdly, improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the controller parameters and event trigger parameters to achieve the optimal dynamic performance of the load frequency control system and reduce the amount of communication data as much as possible; Finally, the simulation results show that the controller not only has good robustness, but also effectively reduces the amount of communication data.

articleTitle: Design of a WSN node for structural health monitoring
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Real-time perception of the structural state is essential for ensuring the structural integrity and safety of the aircraft. Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is an effective method for realizing large-area, distributed structural health monitoring of aircraft. Aiming at the problem of multi-parameter monitoring of aircraft, a multi-parameter WSN for structure health monitoring is developed. Firstly, the overall architecture of the WSN node is designed for the needs of multi-parameter monitoring. Then the hardware and software design are studied separately, as well as the integration of the multi-parameter WSN node is realized. Finally, the verification experiments of the node are carried out. The result shows that the node can effectively monitor the vibration, temperature, humidity, and air pressure of the structure.

articleTitle: Application status of T-connection technology for 35kV transmission line and research on T-connection technology of cross cross arm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, people have higher and higher requirements for power reliability. In the current construction of 35kV transmission lines, in order to solve the problem of insufficient power supply reliability, there are more and more projects to transform the existing lines to increase access power supply. This paper introduces the application status of T-connection technology for 35kV transmission line and designs the head part of T-connection tower with cross cross load.

articleTitle: A Research on the accuracy of Fault Detection Method for Rotor Broken Bar of Asynchronous Motor Based on Voltage Fluctuation
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Asynchronous motors has been used in lots of aspects of daily life and industrial production because of its simple structure, low maintenance cost and long service life. Sensitively and reliably judging the rotor faults of the induction motors is becoming more and more significant. Therefore, lots of rotor bar fault detection methods of asynchronous motor are presented. It is pointed out that the voltage fluctuation will affect the accuracy of rotor bar fault detection methods of asynchronous motor. In order to verify the conclusion, some formulas were derived by taking “the rotor bar fault detection method of asynchronous motor which based on instantaneous reactive power signal analysis” as an example. The author found out that the frequency component of amplitude modulation wave would be reflected in the instantaneous reactive power signal spectrum when the voltage fluctuates, and the accuracy of this kind of detection method would be adversely affected. large number of experiments have been carried out to verify it, and the results show that the conclusion is reliable.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on energy storage system application mode in Jiashan County
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: After a large number of wind power, photovoltaic and other clean energy are connected to the grid, power fluctuation, voltage exceeding the limit and even a small amount of wind and light abandoning appear in local areas of Jiashan power grid. To solve the problem of new energy consumption, one solution is energy storage. This paper analyzes the characteristics of electricity consumption and regional advantages of Jiashan, as well as the policy basis of energy storage application. Further, this paper discusses the application mode of energy storage in Jiashan. Including ntegration of fishing, Light and Storage, Integration of Optical Storage and Charging, Hydrogen Storage System and Mobile Storage Vehicle. Finally, the measures that can be taken to realize the effective utilization of energy storage are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Grid Cost Forecasting Technology Based on Combined Model
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Under the new situation, the investment and construction of smart grids has entered the stage of comprehensive development and construction. In this context, strengthening the level of power grid engineering cost control is not only related to the quality of smart grid construction, but also related to the level of future economic benefits for enterprises. The 110kV overhead line project is an important part of the investment and construction of smart grids. The quality of its cost control directly affects the sustainable operation and development capabilities of power grid companies and the investment capabilities of smart grid construction in the future. Therefore, based on the analysis of the factors affecting the cost of the 110kV overhead line project, this paper constructs a combined project cost prediction model based on regression analysis and gray theory. Finally, combined with actual case analysis, the effectiveness of the prediction model is verified. This forecasting technology can provide a reference for power grid companies to improve their smart grid cost control level.

articleTitle: Research on transaction organization model of source network load storage interaction
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The construction of a new power system will bring a wide access to a high proportion of new energy. Based on the randomness, volatility, dispersion and other characteristics of new energy power generation, it is required that the load side is connected through a variety of equipment such as energy storage and distributed generation, and the energy consumption mode will change from "source with load" to "source network load interaction". This paper studies the transaction organization mode of source network load storage interaction, and organizes interactive transactions through monthly listing transactions, daily power decomposition and interactive deviation assessment, so as to realize the transaction price according to the market and win-win situation of source network load storage.

articleTitle: Detection and Segmentation of Nail Fold Microcirculation Vessels based Deep-learning
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The state detection of nailfold microcirculation vessels is an important way for medical diagnosis of some common diseases. However, most of the parameters of nailfold microcirculation blood vessels are currently determined by artificial means. In order to achieve accurate and automatic measurement of vascular parameters, a method of detection and segmentation of nail fold microcirculation vessels based was proposed. In the process of medical diagnosis, the vascular distribution and blood circulation pathway of nailfold microcirculation were detected based on computer vision method. And the nailfold microcirculation blood vessel detection and segmentation algorithm based on deep learning technology and the centerline extraction method are used to obtain the number of blood vessels, the length of the tube loop, and the diameter of the tube loop, thereby assisting medical detection and improving the efficiency and accuracy of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Adaptation of STPA method on the functional safety development of autonomous vehicle
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As the general trend of the development of autonomous technology in the future, automatic driving has become one of the hotspots that cannot be ignored in the industry. Due to the shortcomings of traditional hazard analysis methods, they cannot be well adapted to the modern automobile safety analysis with intensive software and complicated electronic control units. Under the framework of the current functional safety standard, STPA method is applied to the hazard analysis in the development of its earlier concept stage, and the cause scenarios is identified based on unsafe control behavior, so as to obtain more complete functional safety requirements.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of new T-connected tower with cross cross cross arm for 35kV single circuit transmission line under various working conditions
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the development and progress of national electric power industry, more and more projects are carried out to fulfill the purpose of people's electric power industry serving the people, provide more reliable electric energy, and carry out T-connection transformation of existing lines to increase access to power supply. The original T-connection technology has many disadvantages, such as occupying more land resources, long engineering time and difficult coordination. In order to solve this problem, a new T-connection technology, cross cross cross arm new T-connection tower, has been proposed in recent years. In this paper, finite element analysis is carried out for various working condition combinations of this tower to obtain the influence of various working conditions on the tower.

articleTitle: The necessity of the study of 35kV transmission line cross cross load T tower and the design of single loop T tower jumper
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, people have higher and higher requirements for power reliability. In the current construction of 35kV transmission lines, in order to solve the problem of insufficient power supply reliability, there are more and more projects to transform the existing lines to increase access power supply. But T existing technology in general use to drill the first line and then to the twin towers single or twin towers double two-way connection way back, the T joint technology lever Kentucky number, project covers an area of more than, such problems as high construction cost and outage time is too long, to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a cross cross cross arm T connect way, better overcome the deficiency of the existing T connect way, The jumper of single loop cross cross T pole tower is designed to meet the practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Energy Transaction Model Considering Green Certificate Transaction
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Under the guidance of the carbon neutral target, renewable energy, photovoltaics, biomass and other new energy industries have broad development prospects. With the substantial reduction in the cost of photovoltaic modules, the popularity of user-side photovoltaics has also greatly increased the installed capacity of photovoltaic units, which is renewable. The increase in energy installed capacity places higher demands on the new energy consumption mechanism. But at present, the issuance of green certificates is limited to onshore wind power and centralized photovoltaic power plants. Based on the current development of renewable energy, this article explores the green certificate trading mechanism suitable for distributed photovoltaic and other renewable energy, and achieves the goal of local consumption of renewable energy. After the green card market joined the power market, the economic benefit of unit carbon emission is slightly improved than that when it did not join the green card transaction.

articleTitle: Research on Low Carbon Evaluation Method of Power Grid Based on Combination of Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Power industry is one of the main areas of carbon emission. Comprehensive evaluation of the low carbon level of power grid can not only make grid enterprises have intuitive judgment on their own low carbon development level, but also provide the direction for the country to formulate relevant low-carbon policies in the power industry. Based on the existing researches, this paper uses the degree of application of various smart grid technologies and the relevant factors affecting the carbon emissions of the grid as the evaluation bases, constructs a set of comprehensive low-carbon energy efficiency indicator systems. At the same time, in light of the current lack of qualitative analysis on the low-carbon evaluation of the power grid, an improved super-efficient data envelopment analysis model and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method are proposed to achieve quantitative and qualitative analysis of the low-carbon level of the power grid, and taking part of the regional power grid as a research object, a case study is conducted to verify the practicability and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an SHM System Application Software
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Aircraft components are susceptible to structural damage under load fatigue or flight service conditions, which is not easily observed and poses a great threat to the flight life and personnel safety of the aircraft. In this paper, structural damage and load monitoring software is designed by using LabVIEW virtual instrument platform. First, the functional requirements and overall architecture of the software are analyzed and designed, and data analysis of sensor parameters, monitoring signals and monitoring results are performed. Then, the implementation mechanism and functional architecture of the data acquisition module, damage monitoring module and load monitoring module in the software are described respectively. Finally, the functions and performance of the software are verified by aluminum plate damage and load monitoring tests and wing box section load monitoring tests. The results show that the functions of the software modules are reliable and stable, and the structural damage and load states can be accurately derived by the software.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Intelligent Manufacturing System Based on Internet of Things and Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the development of industrial Internet of Things technology, the manufacturing industry has a strong demand for intelligent manufacturing system and industrial site data collection. The traditional workshop monitoring system lacks the means to visualize, analyze and process the data, and lacks effective monitoring and early warning of production status. In response to this situation, this paper develops a set of intelligent manufacturing system based on Internet of Things technology and virtual reality technology, which can three-dimensionally visualize and intelligently detect industrial site data and production conditions, and provide data basis for manufacturing information management and production decision

articleTitle: Research on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control Strategy of Single-phase Inverter Constant Current Source
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor output current quality of high-power constant current inverter under external disturbance, the linear active disturbance rejection control strategy is applied to the current control of single-phase fullbridge inverter current source. Firstly, the main topology structure of the full-bridge inverter constant current source is analyzed, the mathematical model is established in the synchronous rotating coordinate system, the active disturbance rejection control parameters of the current source are designed, and the anti-disturbance capability to the load and filter parameter changes and external unknown disturbances is analyzed. Then, the simulation experiment of constant current source is built in Matlab/simulink. After simulation comparison, the linear active disturbance rejection control strategy has better output current waveform quality and stronger system robustness than traditional PI control.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of lateral damping strategy of offshore wind power on tower vibration
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Due to the complex operating conditions of offshore wind turbines, the tower is in vibration for a long time, which will not only reduce the output performance of the turbines, but also directly affect the operation accuracy and fatigue life of the relevant parts of the turbines. There are hidden safety hazards, and then affect the effective power generation and operation life of the turbines. This paper takes the offshore wind turbine as the research object and aims to mitigate tower vibration. A control system model based on lateral damping strategy is established. The simulation of offshore variable load conditions is carried out and simulated with GH software. The torque vibration of spindle rotating hub, tower vibration and power output of the wind turbine system are analyzed with the addition of lateral damping, and the correctness of the lateral damping strategy control system model and the effectiveness and advancement of lateral damping strategy to mitigate tower vibration are verified. To provide technical support for further improving the stability of offshore wind turbine operation and ensuring the safe and effective operation.

articleTitle: Research on manipulator motion planning based on improved RRT algorithm
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In the process of manipulator motion planning, the traditional RRT algorithm has problems such as blindness and randomness, and there will be some problems, which will lead to tortuous and lengthy planned paths, and waste computing time for collision detection of a large number of invalid nodes. Therefore, an improved algorithm based on the RRT algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, at the starting point, optimize the sampling space and change the sampling method to avoid the regression of subsequent sampling nodes. Then, at the target point, improve the judgment conditions of the target, dynamically adjust the expanding range of the target point, and speed up the convergence of the node tree. In addition, in the process of node sampling planning, the bias factor of the target is introduced to construct the sampling function, which makes the path heuristic and directional in the process of finding. Finally, by constructing a simple environment and complex environment for simulation experiments, the improved algorithm is compared with the traditional RRT algorithm and RRT star algorithm. Here we verify that the pathfinding time and the number of nodes are relatively reduced by 73.6%, 92.6%, 54.6%, and 75.9%, which proves that the proposed algorithm has higher planning efficiency.

articleTitle: Reliability and economic evaluation of AC / DC distribution network with sensitive load
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the development of distribution network, distributed generation and DC load occupy an increasing proportion in power system. When the connection form of distribution network changes, it is necessary to evaluate the reliability of AC / DC hybrid distribution network on the premise of considering the cost of AC / DC key equipment, so as to comprehensively improve the reliability and economy. Firstly, the grid DC transformation is carried out. For the hybrid AC / DC distribution network including DC sensitive load and distributed generation, the reliability index of hybrid AC / DC distribution network is proposed. Taking the cost of converter, DC circuit breaker, line, converter station, transformer and outage cost as the objective function, the reliability index of each scheme is calculated by Monte Carlo, GWO is used to optimize the configuration scheme of modular multilevel converter and DC circuit breaker considering economic indicators, and the optimal solution is obtained. It is verified that the proposed method can comprehensively improve reliability and economy.

articleTitle: The effect of salinity on the resistivity of frozen soil
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The grounding system is the guarantee for the normal operation of the power system and the key to ensuring the safety of people and equipment. Due to the effect of freezing in seasonally frozen soil regions, the soil resistivity of frozen soil increases significantly, which seriously affects the grounding performance of the system. In this paper, according to the survey results of winter ambient temperature and soil structure in eastern Mongolia, a corresponding soil conductivity model was constructed, and an experimental platform for soil resistivity measurement was built. The four-electrode method was used to measure the resistivity of each treatment. A permafrost test was designed for soil samples with different NaCl concentrations in a constant temperature closed environment of -20 deg C, and the effects of permafrost salinity and temperature on soil resistivity were analyzed. The test results can provide a reference for the grounding system in the frozen soil area.

articleTitle: Attitude Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Six-Rotor Aircraft
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Compared with the four-rotor aircraft, the six-rotor aircraft has a redundant power system, improving its stability and load capacity, and can carry more devices and complete more difficult tasks. To improve the control performance of the sixrotor aircraft, a six-rotor attitude control scheme based on an active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) was designed by analyzing the aerodynamics and rigid body kinematics of the aircraft. First, the input signal is smoothed and differentiated by the second-order differentiator, then the disturbance is observed by the extended state observer. Finally, the nonlinear control law is used to compensate, which can improve the anti-interference ability and stability of the system. The simulation model was built in Matlab/Simulink environment, and the attitude control simulation and anti-interference performance test of the control system were carried out. The simulation results show that the ADRC can adjust the attitude and height quickly, and stably, and has a certain anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: IGBT short circuit and its overvoltage protection circuit
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As a key device in the field of power electronics, IGBT plays an important role in the power electronics industry. Therefore, IGBT short circuit and overvoltage protection has also become an important development direction of power electronics technology. In order to protect high-power IGBT from short-circuit and overvoltage, according to the fact that IGBT Driver passively collects IGBT current and voltage change rate, this paper adopts the method of active clamping of transient voltage suppressor and the combination of short-circuit detection and desaturation detection. Through the comparative analysis of simulation test and simulation software LTSpice, it is compared with the traditional short-circuit protection and overvoltage protection circuit, it has a strong inhibitory effect on the short-circuit state of IGBT and the peak voltage at shutdown. Through the research of driving circuit and protection circuit, these two circuits are used to control the dynamic voltage rise. Experiments show that IGBT can be driven stably without damage due to short circuit and overvoltage.

articleTitle: Cause analysis and Countermeasures of boiler separator outlet overtemperature of Supercritical Unit
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The reasons for the shutdown of a supercritical unit are analyzed in view of the overtemperature of the outlet temperature of the boiler separator caused by the hidden dangers of the coordinated control system and the operation of operators. This paper introduces the logical relationship, dimensional setting and logical hidden dangers of fuel master control in unit coordinated control system, In particular, countermeasures are put forward for the hidden dangers of coordination control logic, Added design when the fuel master command is greater than 70%, increase the boiler master command logic; when the fuel master command is less than 10%, reduce the boiler master command logic, When the deviation between the target fuel value and the actual fuel value in the boiler master control is greater than 3%, cut off the coordination control and feedwater automatic control logic, The water supply disturbance caused by excessive deviation of coal quantity is prevented, and the operation measures of the operator for the pulverizing system of the unit are improved. The optimization of coordination control logic and the improvement of operation measures improve the safety performance of the unit, and provide a reference for similar units.

articleTitle: Optimal operation of electric and thermal integrated energy system considering demand response from the perspective of carbon emission reduction
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In the context of carbon neutrality strategy, an integrated energy system considering demand response can maximize wind and photovoltaic power generation, smooth out the volatility of renewable energy output, and effectively improve clean energy utilization. In this paper, we establish an integrated energy system with wind, photovoltaic and hydrogen production and storage as the core, and use multi-objective particle swarm algorithm to optimize the scheduling of the integrated energy system while considering the carbon emission reduction discount. The results show that the electricthermal integrated energy system can improve the utilization rate of wind and photovoltaic resources while satisfying the load through the effective dispatch of renewable energy resources, and the system operation cost is optimized to achieve the effective synergy of economy and low carbon.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-level and Multi-Objective Optimization of Microgrid Based on Large-scale System Control Theory
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to implement the goal of carbon neutralization, China has vigorously developed new energy in recent years. With the development of new energy, how to improve comprehensive economics of microgrids composed of new energy and conventional power supply became an urgent and realistic problem. This paper proposes a multi-layer hierarchical control structure based on the large-scale system theory to solve the coupling problem of various units in microgrid dispatching. This paper takes wind power generation systems, photovoltaic power generation systems, solar thermal power generation systems, and diesel generators as microgrid's research objects. It takes the microgrid environmental protection index and renewable energy utilization index as the optimization objective. The coupling between the systems is cut off using interaction balance, model simplification, and decentralized predictive control. The joint power generation system is divided into independent subsystems. Local decision-making units are set up for each subsystem to improve the quantum particle swarm algorithm for each subsystem to optimize. The joint system relies on a multi-level hierarchical structure to repeatedly iterate to obtain the optimal solution. Each subsystem uses a model predictive control algorithm to control each unit group's output to achieve the optimal operating state of the joint power generation system and achieve the comprehensive economy of the system Optimal. Finally, a simulation comparison between the decomposition and coordination scheduling based on the large-scale system theory and the complete scheduling based on the improved quantum particle swarm optimization shows that this method can effectively reduce the total power generation cost of the microgrid by about 2,322$, and the calculation time is reduced from 44.2 seconds to 12.5 seconds.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Matching and Optimization of Hybrid Electric Vehicle Power System
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: At present, the number of automobiles in China is growing faster and faster, which brings serious problems such as energy consumption and environmental pollution. Therefore, it is very important to study new energy vehicle technology. In this study, we study the selection and parameter matching of different parts of the power system of the mild electric vehicle, and optimize the parameter matching of the power system of the hybrid electric vehicle by using the whole vehicle model and simulation experiment. In the parameter matching analysis, it mainly studies the parameter matching of engine, drive motor and battery, and analyzes the key points of transmission selection. Through parameter matching and model simulation, it completes the optimization design of hybrid electric vehicle power system.

articleTitle: An Optimal Random Forest Model for occupational frostbite prediction in the grid workplace
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Frostbite is one of the most common diseases in occupational environment. Because of its rapid onset and great harm to human body, there is an urgent need for a machine learning model that can accurately predict the risk of frostbite in workers. In this paper, we introduce a tree model to predict the risk of frostbite incidence using the variable related to working environments. We found the random forest tress outperformed the linear model, which achieved an accuracy over 86.90%. Our model offers a novel approach to for the prevention of occupational frostbite.

articleTitle: Research on market power in the electric power ancillary service market
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Under the objectives of "carbon dioxide peaking and neutrality" and large-scale new energy connected to the grid, the construction of the ancillary power service market has accelerated, the increase of ancillary service entities and the intensified market competition have also caused market power problems. In order to accurately identify market power and control its harm, the article summarizes the characteristics of various types of ancillary service markets in China and other countries, and proposes market power judgment methods suitable for different types of ancillary services, and analyzes the application situations of market power control measures in combination with the cost of ancillary services, and finally summarizes the general ancillary service market power control process. The analysis shows that analyze market power of ancillary services needs to be based on the principle of oligarchy, combined with analysis of market behavior, and ensure fair competition to promote the healthy development of the ancillary service market.

articleTitle: Impact of low temperature climate process in winter 2021 on transmission lines in eastern Inner Mongolia and surrounding areas
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Inner Mongolia and its surrounding areas are often affected by strong wind, cold wave, strong cooling, and other weather in winter, which leads to the frequent occurrence of wind deviation and galloping of overhead conductors of transmission lines in this area, as well as the complexity of vibration forms. Through the construction and operation of low temperature climate monitoring system, statistical analysis is carried out on the impact of low temperature disasters on transmission lines in eastern Inner Mongolia and surrounding areas by the end of 2021, so as to provide scientific and technological support for transmission line equipment management in this area.

articleTitle: Design of Intraoperative Nerve Monitor
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In order to reduce the risk in clinical surgery, reduce the possibility of iatrogenic injury, improve the quality of surgery, improve the patient's surgical prognosis. An intraoperative neuroelectrophysiological monitor was designed and studied in this paper. The monitor is mainly to stimulate the human body to generate relevant electromyography signals, through the sensor signal acquisition, the acquisition of the signal after filtering and amplification processing, transmission to the monitoring host, so as to achieve data transmission and human-computer interaction. C51 microcontroller is used as the main control module. The main control unit controls the pulse stimulator to generate the constant current required for measurement. In the software part, neural network algorithm is used to optimize the collected signals and obtain more accurate and effective signals, so as to improve the safety and reliability of clinical surgery.

articleTitle: Calculation of the carrying capacity of distributed power generation in distribution network under carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Under the " carbon peaking and carbon neutrality " goals and county photovoltaic, the capacity of distributed generation connected to distribution network increases, and the capacity evaluation of distributed generation connected to distribution network is an urgent problem to be solved. Based on the actual operation state and safety boundary of distribution network, particle swarm optimization algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm are combined to form an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. The maximum amount multinode access to DG in the network can be found by the improved particle swarm algorithm. However, due to the soft constraint of the algorithm, the calculation result will cross the constraint value, and then send the calculation result into the power flow screening calculation program to obtain the optimal DG hosting capacity. Finally, use trial value method to find the ultimate DG hosting capacity. The proposed method is implemented on 21node distribution network model. Results confirm the validity of the proposed method. The maximum, optimal and limiting DG hosting capacity of the network is also determined. The corresponding load capacity can be selected according to the actual demand.

articleTitle: Model-Predictive-Control for Dual-Active-Bridge Converter based on Triple-Phase-Shift Control
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Dc-Dc converter can realize the conversion of DC voltage sources and flexible energy conversion; it has the advantages of high efficiency and high-power density. Isolated DC-DC converter has the advantages of electrical isolation of primary and secondary sides, reducing electromagnetic interference and increasing voltage regulation range, which has been widely concerned. The common control strategies of dual active bridge DC-DC converter are phase shift control. The phase shift control using PI regulator is deficient in dynamic performance and cannot meet the requirements of the system. Therefore, this paper adopts model predictive control strategy to optimize the dynamic performance of traditional control strategy. Compared with traditional PI control, it is proved that the proposed method has good dynamic performance in DAB converter and can meet the steady-state performance requirements.

articleTitle: Optimization of intrinsically safe circuits based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: This paper is mainly devoted to solving the parameter optimization problem of intrinsically safe composite circuits. In the design process of intrinsically safe circuits, it is often necessary to solve a series of parameter optimization problems. When the topology is relatively fixed, the optimization problem under most parameters is solved by training a model for different parameters. Unlike the traditional optimization method, different parameters are sampled and trained independently, but through reinforcement learning, The parameter optimization problem is abstracted as environment and agent, the optimization results are obtained by strategy network, the quality of strategy is evaluated by value network, the parameter optimization problem involved in intrinsically safe circuit is solved, and the training process is accelerated; Using the generalization ability of reinforcement learning, we can quickly get the optimal solution in the new intrinsically safe circuit optimization problem, and solve the intrinsically safe circuit optimization problem under different optimization objectives.

articleTitle: An Mesh Segment Algorithm Based On Graph Cuts
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: In many computer vision applications, segmentation of 3D models is crucial. Many alternative segmentation algorithms have been proposed over the past several decades as a result of intensive study. Despite the fact that several automated segmentation algorithms have been presented, finding the relevant component of a mesh with precision is difficult. This study shows how to extract relevant elements from a triangle mesh using an interactive technique and an efficient algorithm. Min-cut, 2D image segmentation methods, is extended to the domain of 3D mesh in this work. It has an onscreen user interface that allows the user to quickly determine the important element. Our strategy is divided into two parts: 1) we simplify a big mesh using a quadric-based surface; 2) we employ min-cut in the simplified mesh.
