The prior cuts in the original mesh are then refined using graph cuts. The method was shown to be valid for mesh cutout in experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Leakage Detection Technology of Long-distance Natural Gas Pipeline Based on Cost Optimization
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Pipeline transportation is an efficient, convenient and environment-friendly transportation mode, especially in the transportation of gas and liquid. It has become one of the five transportation means parallel to railway, highway, aviation and water transportation. However, due to inevitable aging, corrosion and man-made damage, pipeline leakage occurs frequently, resulting in serious economic losses and environmental pollution. Therefore, the real-time automatic detection of pipeline leakage has become an important research topic in the world. There are many methods for pipeline leakage detection. Generally speaking, they can be divided into three categories: information-based method, model-based method and knowledge-based method. Among them, knowledge-based methods have attracted widespread attention from the industry in recent years, mainly focusing on the application of neural networks and expert systems, but these methods have some shortcomings in general. Due to the interference of pressure noise in the pipe, the collected pressure data are inaccurate. The traditional leak detection algorithm is based on the negative pressure wave formed by the pressure in the pipe. With the development and application of computer technology, signal processing, pattern recognition, artificial intelligence and other disciplines, software-based pipeline leak detection technology has become one of the most popular methods because of its advantages of sensitivity, low cost, simplicity and easy operation.

articleTitle: Research on communication access problems and schemes of power control services
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Network reliability is an important indicator of power terminal communication access network. This paper describes a wireless WAN communication terminal. The terminal has multiple SIM modules built in, which can monitor the communication quality of wireless access network in real time, and automatically switch the network according to the monitoring situation, which can greatly improve the reliability of power terminal communication access network, So as to meet the communication reliability requirements of power business. Combined with the communication quality requirements of power services, two channel quality detection methods and channel switching methods of wireless networks are analyzed.

articleTitle: Diagnosis Scheme of Cable Insulation defects based on big data Technology
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The aging of cable insulation is the main cause of cable failure. At present, the transportation inspection department lacks a fast and effective method for cable live detection. The current harmonic method is decomposed according to the defect characteristics, which can effectively analyze the cable insulation defects, but because there are many possible relationships between the defect features and defects, it is difficult to get accurate diagnosis results simply by using the functional relationship. In order to solve this problem, this paper uses the theory of power cable defect harmonic generation, establishes the cable defect harmonic feature database, and puts forward a cable insulation defect diagnosis scheme based on big data technology. It provides big data support for live detection of power cable, and realizes intelligent evaluation and life prediction of cable.

articleTitle: Research on system control method of isolated AC/DC converter
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Isolated AC/DC converter has power bidirectional flow, electrical isolation, high control degree of freedom, high power density and other advantages, plays an important role in energy storage systems, In this paper, the circuit topology, working principle and control method of the converter are deeply studied. An improved control strategy is proposed. The front stage adopts direct current control method, Model predictive control is introduced between front and rear stages, Through MPC, the optimal shift ratio is selected for control in each control cycle. So you don't have to use a PI adjuster to adjust the shift, The time for the system to reach steady state is greatly reduced. A grouping optimization model predictive control method is proposed. By grouping optimization objects into multiple optimization groups, it greatly reduces the amount of computation required for cyclic optimization of model prediction.

articleTitle: Design of Plasma Activated Fog Generator Based on Automatic Detection Technology
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As the epidemic prevention and control has become normal, more and more new disinfection technologies and devices have attracted attention. Plasma contains a large number of charged and neutral particles, which has the characteristics of high efficiency, environmental protection and direct action on human body. In this paper, plasma discharge technology is used to design a plasma activated fog disinfection device, equipped with automatic monitoring system, real-time detection of activated fog ozone concentration and PH value, always keep activated fog ozone within a safe range, will not cause harm to people. At the end of the design, each part of the system is tested, the system basically meets the basic needs of activated fog monitoring, which can improve the efficiency of activated fog monitoring.

articleTitle: Industrial polymerization process quality prediction based on CPSO-LSTM-RNN
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Due to the industrial polymer process is a complex and nonlinear process with the characteristic of multi-variables, hysteresis, large inertia and strong coupling, the main production targets are difficult to measure accurately, and there are fluctuations in data information during the production, so many production data need to be analyzed and processed. Therefore, this paper proposes the CPSO-LSTM-RNN algorithm to predict the yield of industrial polymer process. Firstly, the LSTM-RNN model is established and the model is trained with the data of the production process. Then, the CPSO algorithm is used to obtain the optimal hyperparameters of the model. Finally, the validity of the model is verified by a set of industrial data of the polymerization process.

articleTitle: Integrating deep reinforcement learning into home energy management system based on soft actor-critic framework
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a two-layer home energy management model (HEMS) based on soft actor-critic (SAC) to deal with the uncertainty and complexity of family environment change. Firstly, the scheduling problem in home energy management is transformed into a Markov decision process, and the method of deep reinforcement learning is introduced to solve it. Then, the SAC method is introduced to solve the model. The first layer forms the economic scheduling of household schedulable load on the premise of ensuring comfort, and the second layer optimizes the charging and discharging process of energy storage device on the basis of the decision-making of the first layer, so as to further save the power cost. Finally, the household load public dataset REDD is used for verification. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better performance and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on two-stage allocation method of power grid investment considering investment benefit and grid structure
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Under the background of increasingly strict national investment supervision and increasing pressure on enterprise operation, how to improve the lean management level of power grid investment is of great significance to the operation and development of power grid enterprises. The power grid investment allocation technology is one of the important means to improve the lean management of enterprise investment. Based on this, this paper combines the current situation and characteristics of the investment management of power grid enterprises, and constructs the power grid investment foundation and characteristics from the two dimensions of grid operation status and historical investment results. Adjustment of the two-stage allocation method model. This method first extracts the basic allocation indicators according to the actual situation such as grid size and power grid operation, and then combines the historical investment results to screen the power grid investment allocation adjustment indicators in different regions, and introduces the combination weighting method and index analysis concept to calculate the basic allocation ratio and Adjust the optimization parameters, and finally obtain the optimal results of investment scale allocation in different regions. Finally, an empirical analysis is carried out on the actual situation of power grid investment in a certain area. The results show that the model can realize scientific and reasonable allocation of investment under the situation of grid investment constraints and lean management, improve the precision level of investment management and control, and provide scientific and reasonable allocation of power grid investment. Decision-making provides theoretical support and methodological guidance.

articleTitle: Risk warning model of electric power marketing audit work order based on entropy value method
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Power marketing audit plays an important role in improving the economic benefits of power enterprises. The current audit work order risk early warning model obtains the early warning results by regression processing a large number of historical data, which is not only inefficient, but also difficult to maintain high early warning accuracy. In order to improve the above defects, the risk early warning model of power marketing audit work order based on entropy method will be studied and constructed. After mining work order data by decision tree algorithm, the association between work order businesses is calculated. According to the basic principle of entropy method, two risk indexes of emergency degree and thermal degree are established from the dimensions of time and region. The BP neural network is improved to get the final risk early warning model. The case study shows that the early warning model is not only efficient, but also has an error of 0.12%, which has higher practical application value.

articleTitle: Modelling and Analysis of Electric Shock Simulation for Hybrid Power Supply System
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the increase of new energy power generation and distributed power generation and the development of smart grid technology, the addition of DC power supply will affect the waveform of the generated residual current, which is a composite signal superimposed by various AC and DC waveform. At this time, the traditional residual current circuit breaker has been unable to accurately protect the residual current, and can not meet the requirements of electricity safety. Therefore, the AC and DC residual current waveform bring new challenges to the residual current protection technology. Firstly, the low-voltage AC-DC power supply system is modelled, and the overall models of photovoltaic, energy storage, interface converter and AC-DC power supply system are established respectively. Secondly, the multi-port impedance circuit model of biological electric shock is designed and the simulation of biological electric shock under the AC-DC hybrid power supply system is carried out to obtain experimental data. Finally, based on fast Fourier transform, the spectral characteristics and waveform characteristics of residual current transient signal are analysed. Based on the simulation results of residual current protection of living body electric shock in AC and DC power supply system, this paper uses fast Fourier transform to analyze waveform and spectrum, and studies the variation law of waveform amplitude and phase of living body electric shock data. Design provides the basis.

articleTitle: Current sharing control of four phase interleaved parallel Buck converter
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: High power bi-directional DC-DC converters are widely used in new energy generation and new energy vehicles. The interleaved parallel technology can significantly reduce the output current ripple of the converter, reduce the design cost and increase the power level. Due to the unequal parasitic parameters of each phase, it is easy to make the phase current imbalance, resulting in lower reliability and shorter service life of the converter. To solve the above problem, this paper applies the uniform flow control in the control of multi-phase interleaved parallel converter. The simulation model is built under simulink for analysis, and the experimental prototype is made, and the digital control design is carried out by FPGA to verify the effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: Study on economic performance of natural ester insulated oil transformer
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: As the cooling medium of transformer, natural ester insulating oil has better advantages than traditional mineral insulating oil. This paper compares the advantages and disadvantages of two kinds of insulating oil media from the electrical characteristics and non-electrical characteristics respectively. Natural ester insulating oil transformer has a large investment but long service life; Mineral insulating oil has less investment, but its service life is shorter than that of insulating oil transformer. Therefore, the economic comparative analysis of transformers made of two different insulating oil media from the manufacturing and operation stages is studied, which shows that natural ester insulating oil has good application value in transformer manufacturing.

articleTitle: A weak password scanning scheme of power system based on hot words
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Passwords play an important role in power system security protection. But the existence of weak passwords poses a great threat to the security of the power system. However, the current password management methods of power industrial control systems have loopholes in which some weak passwords are not detected. This paper reference the design method of the PCFG algorithm and proposes a weak password scanning scheme. Hot words and personal information are introduced into the construction of a weak password dictionary for the first time, and the weak password dictionary is expanded based on machine learning technology. Passwords are stored as ciphertext in the power system. According to this characteristic, this scheme calculates the hash value of the weak password dictionary and compares that stored in the target system. This scheme can scan weak password ciphertext and is more suitable for the power system.

articleTitle: Lifecycle analysis and technoeconomics of batteries for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: Electric vehicles (EV) contribute to reducing carbon dioxide emission by replacing the typical internal combustion engine with a battery. The life cycle analysis of the manufacturing and operation of an EV battery is performed through GREET software and different scenarios are set to examine the carbon dioxide emission in its entire lifetime. The techno economics analysis is performed to compare the price of electric vehicles and conventional vehicles, and to investigate the potential monetary effect of imposing carbon tax. The results show that over their lifetime, BEVs will emit only a quarter of the emission of conventional cars in China. Lightweight materials are not expected to lead to significant savings with respect to emissions. From a techno economics perspective, the cost of BEVs is just 10% higher than the price of conventional vehicles currently but it is expected to be 18% cheaper than conventional vehicles by 2030. These results indicate that the deployment of BEVs in China should be encouraged in both the short and long term.

articleTitle: Research on defect detection combining deformable convolution and self-attention
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The surface defect detection of ceramic tiles has always been an important application direction of deep learning. Since the surface of ceramic tiles are mostly small defects, using methods based on traditional methods or ordinary deep neural networks to detect such small defects cannot be well detected. This paper proposes a defect detection network that combines deformable convolution and self-attention: FDTR (flaws detection network with DCN and Transformer). The network can learn the connections between pixels, which improves the ability to detect tiny types of defects. At the same time, because the direction of the flaws is relatively random, a deformable convolution module is added at the end of the feature extraction network, so that the network can not only extract those regular-shaped flaws, but also well extract flaw features with various rotation angles. In addition, because there are some high-resolution images with a size of 8000*6000 in this data set, slicing and splicing of pictures and sample balancing techniques are added to the network to improve the robustness of the network. Finally, the SOTA effect is achieved on the tile defect detection data set.

articleTitle: Review on planning methods of integrated energy system in industrial park
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The integrated energy system can be coupled with cold, thermal, natural gas and electrical energy, which promotes the absorption of renewable energy. The construction of integrated energy system in industrial park is of great significance to ensure the balance of supply and demand in the area. Planning is the first step of the integrated energy system from theory to engineering practice, it lays a solid foundation for the subsequent construction and operation. This paper analyzes the supply and demand in industrial park, sorts out the methods of prediction, summarizes the mathematical model of the overall input and output. Then it presents the general model of industrial park integrated energy system planning and introduces it in three aspects-the objective function, constraint conditions and the solving method. Ultimately, combining with the background of low-carbon, it looks forward to the research direction in the future.

articleTitle: Efficiencies of Solar Cells: Present and Future Development
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: The energy shortage has been obstruction for economic development, while solar energy is clean, renewable and regarded as a solution. Solar cells have developed for decades and the key factor is their photo-to-electron conversion efficiency. Three generations of solar cells are categorized, which are silicon-based cells, thin film cells and advanced new-type cells concerning perovskite and quantum dot. We review the improvements of silicon-based cells in efficiency, summarizing critical breakthrough in structural design and fabricating techniques that make the efficiency of them close to their theoretical limit recently. Furtherly we give analysis of electronic characterizations of perovskite and quantum dot solar cells, projecting potential options to obtain higher efficiencies in future works. Commercial factors including cost, large-area fabrication are also discussed in this review.

articleTitle: Collaborative Design Knowledge Conflict Resolution Aided Negotiation Activation Strategy Based on Conflict Degree
publicationTitle: ECITech 2022; The 2022 International Conference on Electrical, Control and Information Technology
abstract: With the increasing complexity of engineering design objects, online collaborative design is considered to be a way to solve complex design problems by using multidisciplinary teams and parallel work. However, the coexistence of collaboration and competition among interdisciplinary teams, the coexistence of the consistency of the overall design goals and the heterogeneity of individual knowledge, causes frequent conflicts in the design process. The traditional integrated conflict resolution strategy adopts the corresponding conflict resolution strategy to solve the conflicts in order based on the conflict classification. Essentially, conflict resolution is regarded as a static resolution process, which is a repetitive work of "detecting conflicts and resolving conflicts". This article defines the concept of conflict degree by integrating the three dimensions of conflict subject contradiction degree, conflict object complexity and conflict problem impact degree, and links conflict with the collaborative design process, and regards the conflict process as a dynamic development process with the design process. On this basis, for conflicts with a high degree of conflict, the strategy of direct activation assisted negotiation is adopted to shorten the conflict resolution cycle and improve the quality of conflict resolution. Based on the modeling and calculation method of conflict degree, the negotiation process is explained.
